| | Team -- Opponents of voting rights have made a strong bet. They've doubled down on it the last few years, too. Their bet was that we'd only care about certain states. That as long as we were focused on the swing states like Arizona, Georgia, Pennsylvania, and others, they would be free to suppress votes in states like Utah, South Dakota, Mississippi, or Kentucky. And you know what? **That bet has paid off for them.** When Wisconsin tried to ban drop boxes, there was an immediate reaction and lawsuits. But not when South Dakota did the same. When Texas started messing with changes to voter ID requirements, people howled. But when Utah functionally suppressed the youth vote with new ID requirements, they got away with it. **They've created a feedback loop:** States with restrictive voting laws receive little attention because they aren't electorally competitive. But part of the reason they aren’t competitive is because _their state laws prevent large segments of the population from voting_. **[Team, we cannot afford to skip any state when it comes to protecting our fundamental right to vote. clean_body: Opponents of voting rights are betting we'll let them run free| | | Fighting in every state that's trying to suppress voters doesn't mean we're going to ignore the big purple states that get all the attention, Team. But the truth of the matter is that the time and resources spent to protect voting rights are not evenly split across states , harming some of our fellow citizens because they live in one state instead of another. | | | Team -- Opponents of voting rights have made a strong bet. They've doubled down on it the last few years, too. Their bet was that we'd only care about certain states. That as long as we were focused on the swing states like Arizona, Georgia, Pennsylvania, and others, they would be free to suppress votes in states like Utah, South Dakota, Mississippi, or Kentucky. And you know what? That bet has paid off for them. When Wisconsin tried to ban drop boxes, there was an immediate reaction and lawsuits. But not when South Dakota did the same. When Texas started messing with changes to voter ID requirements, people howled. But when Utah functionally suppressed the youth vote with new ID requirements, they got away with it. They've created a feedback loop: States with restrictive voting laws receive little attention because they aren't electorally competitive. But part of the reason they aren’t competitive is because their state laws prevent large segments of the population from voting. If you've saved your payment information with FastAction, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | We've highlighted things in these things in the past , like voter ID in Utah or court decisions in Kansas or the most suppressive state-level voting law in Indiana, but we have to fight harder there. The danger in ignoring the voting rights of citizens in more than half the country is that it creates a two-tiered democracy. Voters in the swing states benefit from attention and legal actions, while voters everywhere else are left to navigate increasingly onerous and burdensome requirements without meaningful support or scrutiny. We have to fight everywhere. Donald Trump is actively dismantling democratic institutions and undermining the rule of law. Only through free and fair elections can we hope to restore our republic. We've endorsed three women so far who can replace three of them: Christina Bohannan (IA-01) , Marlene Galán-Woods (AZ-01) , and Rebecca Cooke (WI-03). = = | = 100% of your donation goes to the campaigns Let's talk about who our EMILYs List champions are up against: Rep. Mariannette Miller-Meeks (IA-01) literally ran away from journalists at the Capitol after voting to cut Medicaid, even though she promised she wouldn't. Rep. David Schweikert (AZ-01) actually bragged about sleeping through a vote that threatened health care for nearly 100,000 people in his district. And Rep. Derrick Van Orden (WI-03) is so deep in the MAGA echo chamber he voted to increase the deficit, give tax cuts to the wealthy at the expense of working families, and slash food stamps — which his own family relied on when he was growing up! Make no mistake, this race will be extremely close, and the Senate majority will likely run through Michigan. That’s why we can’t afford to sit back, Peter.

🗳️Texas’ current congressional map is already gerrymandered and is already being sued for violating the Voting Rights Act — a mid-decade redraw that makes the gerrymandering even more extreme could **further dilute the voting power of marginalized communities.**
💰Texas Governor Greg Abbott has called the state legislature into a special session to make changes to the map, **which will cost taxpayers unnecessary money.** He has not added redistricting to the docket, but he still has time to do so. A 30-day special session in Texas has the price tag of anywhere from $1-$3 million, all coming from taxpayers’ wallets.
📉Redrawing a map mid-decade to tilt election results in favor of one political party **sets a dangerous precedent, one that bypasses the traditional redistricting process** tied to new census data.
**We’re calling it what it is: Trump is attempting to manipulate a congressional map by pressuring state lawmakers to engage in a “ruthless gerrymander” for partisan gain is a direct blow to American democracy.**

clean_body: Gov. Abbott must reject extremists who want to manipulate maps | Hey Peter, Earlier this month, the New York Times broke the news that President Trump is actively pressuring lawmakers in Texas to redraw their congressional maps mid-decade. This is alarming for many reasons: 🗳️Texas’ current congressional map is already gerrymandered and is already being sued for violating the Voting Rights Act — a mid-decade redraw that makes the gerrymandering even more extreme could further dilute the voting power of marginalized communities. 💰Texas Governor Greg Abbott has called the state legislature into a special session to make changes to the map, which will cost taxpayers unnecessary money. He has not added redistricting to the docket, but he still has time to do so. A 30-day special session in Texas has the price tag of anywhere from $1-$3 million, all coming from taxpayers’ wallets. 📉Redrawing a map mid-decade to tilt election results in favor of one political party sets a dangerous precedent, one that bypasses the traditional redistricting process tied to new census data. We’re calling it what it is: Trump is attempting to manipulate a congressional map by pressuring state lawmakers to engage in a “ruthless gerrymander” for partisan gain is a direct blow to American democracy. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = Here’s the thing, Peter: Redistricting is no longer on a once-per-decade redrawing cadence. Because partisan extremists are determined to seek unfair advantages, they are willing to manipulate maps whenever and wherever it benefits them — even if that’s outside of the typical redistricting cycle that comes with the census. Just a few states away in Ohio, state lawmakers are preparing for a mid-decade redraw of their congressional map because of previous partisan attempts to gerrymander and skew results to lock in a certain majority. It’s no surprise, given the notorious history of extremist Ohioan lawmakers of manipulating maps. And get this: The Ohio Supreme Court has struck down gerrymandered maps there a whopping SEVEN times — five times for the legislative maps, and twice for the congressional maps. While Ohio is already in the spotlight, Texas is now under pressure from the President of the United States. Across the country, ideological extremists are engaging in a coordinated effort to manipulate maps for partisan gain — all while diluting the power of the people, bending the rules, and weakening the foundation of our democracy. From organizing communities in states like Texas and Ohio to educating voters across the country about the efforts of anti-democracy forces, we’re advocating to ensure that every person has fair representation. subject: Did you meet any inspiring young leaders at No Kings protests?

body:
Young people are on the frontlines of the fight for our future.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20250626-1&t=1&akid=2304%2E587540%2ErEcy80)
Peter, we want to hear from you.
There were countless inspiring young leaders who spoke at No Kings protests this month. And in so many other instances, young people have been leading the charge, organizing their communities, and reminding us what courage looks like.
**Young people are on the frontlines of the fight for our future.**
Our mission at Leaders We Deserve is to empower the next generation of progressives to step up and run for office — and to give them the support they need to win their races.
**_We’re ready to get to work._** But we need this team to help us identify young leaders. We need folks in every part of the country helping recruit the next generation of Democrats.
**[Peter, this will only take a minute. Tell us about a young person in your community who should run for office. Just share their information and we’ll take care of the rest!](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/survey/em_ms_lwd_20250626_1/?source=em20250626-2304&akid=2304%2E587540%2ErEcy80)**
**The next generation is ready to run for office. We’re here to help make sure they win.**
We believe in building power from the ground up. And we believe that young people can compete everywhere — open seats, swing seats, and safe blue seats alike. But it’s going to take a massive network to identify leaders across the country. So we’re turning to you:
**[If you know about a young leader who should be on our radar, click here to let us know.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/survey/em_ms_lwd_20250626_1/?source=em20250626-2304&akid=2304%2E587540%2ErEcy80)**

7 years ago, Alexandria and a team of grassroots volunteers — all of whom were everyday people from the community who believed in her message for a better world — changed the country by knocking thousands of doors and having real conversations with their neighbors about their representation in Congress.
**We’re celebrating their victory by rereleasing the campaign buttons they used to share Alexandria’s message in 2018.**
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250626-buttons.VU3r-f&refcode=em20250626-9183-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9183%2E2526796%2E1jSqrg)
Because we still stand for **people over profits.**
We still believe in improved, expanded, and guaranteed **Medicare for All.**
And we still believe that **ICE is a rogue agency that should not exist.**
Some people call Alexandria ‘radical’ for believing we can win a government that works for all of us — but **we believe a better world is possible.**
[Donate $10 or more to get your limited-edition buttons and stand with us as we continue to fight for housing as a human right, a Green New Deal, and so much more.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250626-buttons.VU3r-f&refcode=em20250626-9183-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=9183%2E2526796%2E1jSqrg)
**[Get your buttons →](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250626-buttons.VU3r-f&refcode=em20250626-9183-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=9183%2E2526796%2E1jSqrg)**
Happy 7 Year Anniversary to dunking on haters and advocating for peace!
In solidarity,
Team AOC

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20250626-buttons?refcode=em20250626-9183-P_FND_EGR_GRM&t=22&refcode2=9183_2526796_1jSqrg&akid=9183%2E2526796%2E1jSqrg)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20250626-9183-P_FND_EGR_GRM&t=23&akid=9183%2E2526796%2E1jSqrg)**

clean_body: - the name's Earl LeRoy Carter. You can just call me Buddy. And I'm hoping that soon, folks will know me as the regular ol' Christian guy from small-town Georgia who dethroned Democrat Jon Ossoff. After my family and I prayed for a long time, we decided to pull the trigger for 5 key reasons: 1\. Jon Ossoff has no business being a Senator for Georgia - he's a liberal Democrat who voted to allow men in women's sports, he campaigned hard for Kamala Harris, and the last straw was when he agreed that President Trump should be impeached. Get outta here! He's all hat and no cattle, if you know what I mean. 2\. This is the GOP's top pickup opportunity in the country - Jon Ossoff barely won last time and he's since abandoned any semblance of being moderate. He's extremely vulnerable and polls show a huge opening for a strong conservative to flip this seat. On top of that, President Trump won Georgia by 5 points just months ago! 3\. Republicans need this seat - the only (and I mean only) way Democrats could win back the Senate is by keeping Georgia. If Republicans flip this seat, it'll cement a GOP-controlled Senate for President Trump's entire term AND help us hold the line in 2028 too. 4\. It'll take the right conservative to win this race - other Republicans may run, but not just anyone can win. Some of my potential opponents hate President Trump; others will be chewed up and spit out by the Democrat machine. I've got Trump's back 100%! 5\. I know that I can actually win - Stacey Abrams, Jon Ossoff, and the Democrats have built a formidable voter turnout machine here. Luckily, I've been rallying Republican (and independent) voters for as long as I can remember, and shoe-leather politics is going to make the difference between victory and defeat. I'm the right man for the job. The starting bell just rang for the biggest fight of my life. I am 100% confident I can flip this Senate seat but I'm counting on the help of every conservative in America to win. you'd be willing to give would be a Godsend! Jon Ossoff just SHATTERED a fundraising record by raking in 11 million bucks this year alone. Frankly, this race will come down to folks like you stepping up and kicking in small donations here and there. Victory will come down to that, I'm afraid. God bless America,-Buddy Earl LeRoy "Buddy" CarterMAGA Conservative for US Senate * | | Paid for by Buddy Carter for Senate PO Box 10570 Savannah, GA 31412

name: Kirk Cameron
subject: Bring wholesome messaging back to children’sentertainment
body:
Please – for the sake of all our families

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith,Please – for the sake of all our families – take it from me as someone who’s lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with “entertainment” that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue’s Clues_...
---
[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z7cunqbt5qknolgff6s4o1ogdkv6ivl8gltb5j38_rp22sh2s8i6epb4c1i61ob4cjh2bs)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to “educate” YOU about your “old-fashioned” and “mean” ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. **[Today, I’m inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zg4jotodk922v216396tmli82svkjpj1cu285n88_rp22sh2s8i6epb4c1i61ob4cjh2bs)** Introducing: _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I’m making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you’ve seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we’ve already countered those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic “Story Hours” of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It’s encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we’re working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we’ve already completed and released the first ten character-building episodes of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_! We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone – including folks just like you – who worked so hard to get us that far. But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we’ve made the first five episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE. That’s the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can’t get the word out. And the Left will try to bury _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 – and with the recent launch, we need to raise the funds immediately.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $250,000 for post production.**_
---
I know that’s a lot of money but it’s actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won’t work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That’s why I’m asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $250,000 for Season 2.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zl89ib04jhmjmpuvehml22j1qi11fo0mm8bcnlh0_rp22sh2s8i6epb4c1i61ob4cjh2bs) ** As our special “Thank You” for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we’ll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ FREE on DVD.This exclusive _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. It won’t be available for sale anywhere. So with **[**your gift of $50**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z786ofvc7rdq33cg40dn77p8nvd8h8i7vrk9l7p0_rp22sh2s8i6epb4c1i61ob4cjh2bs)** , you’ll be part of a small select group of people who own our wholesome TV show on DVD. You’ll have it ready to watch with the children in your life. Or you can drop your DVD by your local school, church, mission, or even leave it in the waiting room at your doctor’s office. So many children have no way of hearing God’s message in their lives. Your random act of kindness may change a child’s life. **[So please – whether you can send $50, $5,000, $25,000, or anything higher or lower, please respond quickly and know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zkde69u3rnda51r113610slql4tn59kqq48qkh60_rp22sh2s8i6epb4c1i61ob4cjh2bs)** There’s no time to waste. Hollywood groomers have destroyed America’s Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes.And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family – not filth.Thank you for being a part of history by becoming a **Founding Supporter** of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.
---
Sincerely,
---
| | Kirk Cameron (and Iggy!)Actor, Author, and Father
---
| [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zghddfr51pvseema6c6hqlp5ngbg4du3l59rume0_rp22sh2s8i6epb4c1i61ob4cjh2bs)

---
**Kirk Cameron (and Iggy!)** **Actor, Author, and Father**
---
|
---
| | P.S. The #1 thing you can do today to stop the Hollywood groomers who are tearing families apart – maybe even yours – is to support the very first children’s television show in _history_ made possible by contributions from grandparents and seniors like you. **[Please send in your Founding Supporter gift and help me reclaim America with the Biblical values our country was founded upon.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z25gdmq5i9ea87n58mc38qhbfvschafsfq7mpqi0_rp22sh2s8i6epb4c1i61ob4cjh2bs)** Thank you and God bless you and your family! -- Kirk

**Good Morning!** On this day in 1985, after 59 years, the iconic [Route 66](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOqzAQheGnMZ2RGYgdChe3octtt0QDHoeJjB3ZThBvv8pq32DrTzpH-r9u8w05cLz_x51s9WmOdJRAtVKenxhxz1RfOZZIxwN3KkuKzs2g4CKVlmBmhxzOeWic9URAfUO2M5dOdVc9jM1mxysYNY6AOK7e4dBfdL8QOoLRr1cDDdvPmtJgOqUGZdredHpclhW9WZ3qUAyKHNeU20fiWDfy4Uxvyu2a9ibYrdZnEf0_AZOA6TiOduNSUz4_LmCqGxfp8JQc5a8ImB6vSBKMgCmnVyWptXS0Uq7smVyTrXseHAIXbcSg7jty-Pmrf4r0tvAdAAD__3SSfLc) was decertified and its highway signs removed by the American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials. In _Friday Entertainment_ , we're spotlighting news about the next James Bond film [getting a new director](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGO4yAQxvGnwR3WMDjgFBSnO_mqbLulhc3YIcIQAYnlt185r7D1XxrN7_u-jTfrg4_rl93I1CWNkfYSqFbK49NGu2WqrxxLpP1hNypTis6NCHjhoDjq0VkfjrFrnFmIkGRDRuiLANGr7trcDZAFINnTLJSCnjRJNwt1IalcJyw23pzXQKEWAB3oVmqhrtM020XPDoRlHZDzNeX2kXysd1rCkd6U2zltTTD3Wp-FyT8MB4aDneZT0K7pzAyH_7ez_H2F-srEcIi084-EnxS-pbcnvlItPNBK0dl8cOczzTVlhkOpKR9MDt4x-U-gRMSr6pts3HP3IfiiNOtg3awPn3_qr0Z8G_wJAAD__4_zhfY). The announcement has us thinking about our own Bond memories. What was the first James Bond film you ever saw, and which one remains the most memorable for you? Hit reply and let us know. ## Supreme Court Rules Against Planned Parenthood
The Supreme Court ruled Thursday that states can [block Medicaid funding to Planned Parenthood](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLuO6yAURb_G7rDg-EEoKG6TLred0jqG45gMDwtIUP5-lPmF6bf20lpft_WGzrt4_4-BdN3TGqkVT7VSXk-MGDLVZ44lUntgoLKlaO0KHGbGFwZytej8e516q3cioLEnLeQsuLgsk-oPzQXhvikzXWaaLEiU6rKA4kYa2DY19k5_3vgCUnA-cTmMUixq2wzu0lgusJs4WVdTHh7JxXrQ7t_pRXkwKfReH7WepRv_dXDt4NpaGz4Kjej7M-jgWp5npkDMpGeuLJB1Bp1lp8cYybITM8V6pGSZJeOKS5EBV0LM0Gdtz-a8d2WR3cTvAZ3_xdY_tXpp-AkAAP__MWd_tg), a victory for Republicans who have sought to defund the nonprofit group. The 6-3 decision, with the court's three liberal justices dissenting, ruled for South Carolina over its effort to defund Planned Parenthood, concluding that individual Medicaid patients can't sue under federal civil rights laws to enforce their right to pick a medical provider. South Carolina Gov. Henry McMaster had been pushing to block public health dollars from [going to Planned Parenthood.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O6yAURldjd1iAf0gKite4y2untK7hYt8IAwIcT3Y_ymxh6k_6dM75eiwPIE9h-w8H6uriEvAqHmvFvCQIcGSsZw4l4PWEA8sag7WL5HJkfGJSLRbIv5ehtdohSuxb1EKNgovbNNzbXa9yFWqUgrse1ODASI6uH2_mrvAmxdCS_rzxSSrB-cBV1ysx3dfVgFPGcgHNwNFSjbl7Rgp1R-ff8YW5M_Fovd5rTaXp_zVybuR8XVfn4vfH4rM3ck7RUyVTGjmXM2U8kJl45sry6bEw2IBCqSx5CAEtS5Ax1D1Gyw60ZIAsc2ewFDZmqaSzYpu1TRd5T2VSzcC3A8j_0tQ_JXxp-RMAAP__m_aJvA) Lower courts had ruled in favor of a patient at Planned Parenthood South Atlantic who argued that blocking the funds violated her rights under the Medicaid Act.

The "The Pan Am: 2025 Tracing The Transatlantic Voyage" will run from today to July 9, featuring a private Boeing 757-200 configured for just 50 passengers with lie-flat seats. See . The 13-day, 12-night journey will recreate Pan Am's original transatlantic routes, stopping in Bermuda, Lisbon, Marseille, London, and Foynes, Ireland, with luxury hotel accommodations included. . Tickets cost $59,950 for shared accommodations. The price covers airfare, lodging, most meals, and Pan Am-branded souvenirs. . TV's Bill Moyers Dies at 91 Bill Moyers, former White House press secretary under President Lyndon Johnson and longtime public television journalist, from prostate cancer. Moyers served in Johnson's administration from the Senate to the West Wing, later hosting a number of public affairs shows on PBS. His programs often focused on politics, health, and religion, and he was known for his interview series with mythologist Joseph Campbell. He stepped away from public life in 2017 after decades in journalism and public broadcasting. ## Current, Former Paxton Aides Trade Accusations
Current and former top deputies for Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton are embroiled in a heated legal dispute that could threaten his campaign for U.S. Senate. Recent polls have shown Paxton with a [solid lead](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb_GdKDxPIOhcLENXbbdEhkYw0jGRrYTkr9fkV94zegUo3uu7r_H9LDsOWx_7UGmvF2cAl3ZUymUpiMm8lx2fh4HBw6bUnCkaNcJAdsauhr1tFr2n0lVq5lhHWRFRupWAiJoqHaj9TL0kuxPa2mmAeQsnZuddBpa3eNcsbnDoEMtJUjoG-iVUw5sq6VzmkgooJVLTE3ZqdDbZuc_8UWpWeJRebOXcmbx80fgKHC8rqs5o-fCS7wfBI6eX1Q_z9UWygLHWydwhO7m-ywxbIly_mIKn1Cf9l1iqM_off011gAK1TCoKpn1vNh7zp0WCrbDsv8WKb-b72XwfwAAAP__unqCZg) over incumbent John Cornyn for the Republican nomination. Last month, a lawsuit filed by current staffer Jordan Eskew alleged that former Solicitor General Judd Stone and Assistant Attorney General Chris Hilton were [forced to resign](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OGyEURp-G6bAuLB7sgsJSNEqzSZlydBcu9lX4cQDveN8-Gr_Ctt8nHR2dP-_rO3Licv2Fmdx4xroW2nqiMaituTZKPG78yJkLl6sxkFvFsGrQRwmz1HYNyOlrNVNwHxDOaiKn7FGB1mBhurmgw4mO57OPMH9gtCbiWfk3PWNQFpSf2O0wmLVVChScDnAy0UTAo1UxWiJhgAKP2g7jRoOe2GP6qp_UDr7mKbnbGPcu3i5CL0Iv27Ydci_7J_RCRT660ItvnEno5UqFGqZ9ebRGZchYW6Ym_1KRd3yOWmQfGCO1LkfDQDJz97WEhx_SJ-TcJRdZaJPxFW6nY5OXi_r5z_z-MTUX7hunxH22wsA1I6eX6Phe3k-n_wcAAP__wjuQ3Q) in 2023 for engaging in sexual harassment. The filing contained an email from current First Assistant Attorney General Brent Webster in which he claimed Stone admitted to the behavior. _Who in the world thinks it 's OK for biological males to compete against our girls and young women in sports?!_

We saw another recent example of this nonsense here in Texas. In late April, at the U.S. Masters Swimming Spring National Championships held in San Antonio, a biological male took first place in FIVE Women's individual events. Hugo "Ana" Caldas dominated in two events by a whopping four seconds.

I've said it before, and I'll say it again: **It is fundamentally wrong and unfair to force girls to compete against girls in sports and to force women to compete against men in sports.**

I will not relent in this fight.

The Democrats are _OUT OF THEIR MINDS_ and we cannot let them prevail. [**JOIN ME IN STANDING STRONG FOR OUR GIRLS AND YOUNG WOMEN >>>**](http://trk.tedcruz._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1FLUhvdXNlRmlsZSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Q3J1el9LZWVwLUJveXMtT3V0LU9mLUdpcmxzLVNwb3J0c18yMDI1MDYxOSZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPUVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUtlZXAtQm95cy1PdXQtT2YtR2lybHMtU3BvcnRzJnV0bV9hZ2VuY3k9UEcmYW1vdW50PTc1In0/UDLv7UOginSPyBFKEO8ybA)

_Do you know who DOES support this assault against the integrity of women 's sports?_

Well, we have the Senate Democrats - earlier this year, they voted UNANIMOUSLY to let this crap continue, _when they filibustered the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act_.

name: Casey Given
subject: Powerful Story: She left Iran for freedom
body:
What would you give up for your freedom?

|
---
| | [](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zdgopqhocjg6v2crpjnd1ffbveqe062293eoa3mo_rp22sh2s8i6epb4c1j69p36c1h2bs) Friend,

What would you give up for your freedom?

Most Americans are fortunate enough never to have to make this decision, but for Tahmineh Dehbozorgi, it was a decision she faced at a young age.

Growing up as a woman in Iran, she was denied even the most basic rights.
* She couldn’t pursue her dreams.
* She couldn’t sing in public.
* She had no freedom of speech, no freedom of religion, and no individual liberty.

What she did have was the courage to walk away from it all.

**Tahmineh left behind her family, her friends, her culture — even her native language — because she wanted something greater: freedom.**

It’s stories like hers that American high schoolers need to hear.

Now, Tahmineh found freedom in the United States and is a citizen.

**Tahmineh Dehbozorgi, like many of the Dissident Project’s speakers, shares her story of fleeing a tyrannical regime with American high schoolers at no cost.**

[You can help bring Dissident Project speakers like Tahmineh’s to American high schools across the country by donating today >>>](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z2sn0069b4eg1hqro3aid1r9maj84jqfht41ohm0_rp22sh2s8i6epb4c1j69p36c1h2bs) [Support Dissident Project](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z4neidoi50scab335bpgkmq2sifi1ar02gs182m8_rp22sh2s8i6epb4c1j69p36c1h2bs)
The Dissident Project is helping young Americans connect the dots between authoritarianism and lost freedom — and they’re doing it with powerful, personal experiences.

We oppose socialism, fascism, and all forms of tyranny.

By bringing our speakers to high schools, we help teach the younger generation about the true horrors of big government and instill a sense of patriotism for American freedom.

Many American students may be unfamiliar with life outside of the United States or have trouble understanding what people in other countries go through. They are comfortable with the idea of giving the government more power, and think it will be in their best interest.

**But they don’t understand how difficult life can be once the government takes over completely.**

The Dissident Project speakers know how to connect our experiences to the principles that have made America prosperous and why we must defend them.

**Your gift helps amplify the voices of brave men and women who’ve escaped oppression and are now standing up for liberty. **

Please donate today and help make sure their voices are heard.

Casey Given

“You did not seek this moment. **This moment sought YOU.** ”
“I will not abandon this post. Our flag will NOT come down.”

And today, we’re asking YOU to stand with him—and with Ambassador Huckabee—at one of the most pivotal moments in modern history.
This is not just about politics.

Peter, when I first arrived in Washington to serve Colorado in the US Senate, I’ll be honest: it was a lot to take in.
See, I had served in public office before, but I was still *far* from being a typical politician. And I knew all too well about Washington’s reputation of partisanship and gridlock.
**[I’m going to tell you more about how I’m breaking through the noise in Washington and delivering results for working families — but first, will you consider splitting a donation between Heartland Patriots and my campaign to keep this Senate seat blue?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/90697?refcode=em20250627-9052&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=9052%2E614464%2EYaJRGf)**

My path to serving in the US Senate looked a little different from the typical politician you’ll find in Washington. I’m a laid-off geologist who became a local brewer, and I first ran for Mayor of Denver because the concerns of everyday Coloradans simply weren’t being addressed. And since then, no matter what office I’ve held, I’ve worked to put Colorado families and communities first.
Despite the dysfunction we’ve seen from Washington lately, I’m proud to say that grit, integrity, and hard work has paid off in the time I’ve served Colorado in the Senate.
I got my hands dirty working hard in the Senate to make real change for Coloradans. We invested billions of dollars to confront the climate crisis, lowered prescription drug costs, made investments to rebuild our infrastructure, and brought thousands of good-paying manufacturing jobs back to America.
And in this unprecedented and critical moment, I’m fighting tooth and nail to oppose Trump’s cruel cuts to Medicaid, protect Colorado’s public lands, and preserve all of the progress we’ve made over the past few years.
**Americans don't want to see more chaos and dysfunction in Washington — they’re counting on us to deliver real relief and progress on the issues that matter most, and that’s what we’ll always do.**

Fellow activist,

During these unprecedented times, our nation is navigating a new reality that we have never before encountered. From voting rights being stripped away and attempts to politicize our courts to attacks on immigrant communities, climate responsibility, social safety net programs, and much more. **NOW is the TIME to invest in our work to engage voters year-round – it has never been more important. **

Here’s the thing: **Across the ecosystem, funding is scarce.** It is harder to raise funds during odd-year elections, but they are just as important, especially for Pennsylvania in 2025. Unfortunately, judicial elections are overlooked by the electorate in the Commonwealth and low turnout in judicial election years can be credited to low information/civic education around the elections, the judicial candidates and the roles judges play in defending democracy in general. In order to change that, **we must INVEST in year-round civic education and engagement. **

**More than ever before, we are depending on the power of individual grassroots donations to fuel our organization. That is why we are reaching out today. **

We need your help not only to maintain our current level of operations but also to ramp up as we prepare for the crucial Supreme Court retention elections and other judicial, local and municipal elections in Pennsylvania.

[**Thanks to a generous angel donor, all donations up to $50,000 will be DOUBLED, but we only have a few weeks left to take advantage of this opportunity. The ink is barely dry on Mamdani’s historic victory — but already, the
billionaire class and their political allies are scrambling to stop him.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/32192?source=email-20240627&t=1017&akid=8935%2E5885482%2EAtovpa ]Headline: Billionaires Ackman and Musk Blast Zohran Mamdani's Primary
Win - Catsimatidis Predicts Adams Could Win

We’ve seen this story before. The establishment and their billionaire
donors did everything they could to block Bernie’s grassroots movement.
Now, they’re coming for Mamdani — and they won’t stop there.

That’s why Bernie and seven Senate allies are demanding an immediate ban
on billionaire-funded super PACs and dark money in Democratic primaries.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/32192?source=email-20240627&t=1018&akid=8935%2E5885482%2EAtovpa ]Add your name now to stand with Bernie and Mamdani, and demand the
Democratic Party say NO to dirty billionaire money!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/32192?source=email-20240627&t=1019&akid=8935%2E5885482%2EAtovpa ]ADD YOUR NAME

Dark money and super PACs are the weapons of the ultra-wealthy — and
they’re being deployed right now to undermine Mamdani, protect corporate
power, and handpick candidates who won’t challenge the status quo.

The fact is Americans overwhelmingly agree: money should never equal
political power. Yet so far Democratic Party leadership has REFUSED to
sever ties with oligarchs. And that’s EXACTLY why some of them are casting
votes that advance Trump’s agenda – like the crypto-corruption GENIUS Act
– when it serves their big donors.

It’s time to end this rigged system and end the oligarchs' grip on our
democracy, starting with the Democratic Party.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/32192?source=email-20240627&t=1020&akid=8935%2E5885482%2EAtovpa ]Add your name now. Tell Democratic Party leaders to follow Bernie’s
lead and ban billionaire-funded super PACs from our primaries.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/32192?source=email-20240627&t=1021&akid=8935%2E5885482%2EAtovpa ]ADD YOUR NAME

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/32192?source=email-20240627&t=1022&akid=8935%2E5885482%2EAtovpa ]No Oligarch Money graphic

Together, Our Revolution activists have spearheaded victories all across
the nation – from local elections to state party platforms – by boldly
demanding politicians refuse big-money donors.

Now is our moment to do it again, on a national scale, and send a crucial
message to Democratic leaders still courting the billionaire class: our
democracy is not for sale!

When we organize, we win.

I am leading the charge to build the conservative environmental movement. And I’m inviting you, Friend, to join our ranks.

The American Conservation Coalition has over 75,000 conservatives in the fight.

We rival the Sierra Club, but we are NOT Radical Leftists!

name: Tim Kaine
subject: Trump’s budget will add $3 trillion to the deficit
disclaimer_text: paid for by gutting programs that help working families, children, and seniors
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025]
Derek, a new report from the Congressional Budget Office has confirmed what many of us already knew:
The GOP budget is a massive giveaway to the wealthy, paid for by gutting programs that help working families, children, and seniors.
And the cherry on top? This budget would increase the national deficit by $3 trillion .
Here’s what else Trump’s “One, Big, Beautiful Bill” could do:
* Force up to 16 million people to either lose their health insurance entirely, or see their premiums skyrocket.
* Slash the children’s health insurance program (CHIP), which helps cover over 9 million kids.
* Force more than 200,000 Virginians to lose access to nutritional assistance programs (SNAP), or see their benefits cut, even as grocery prices keep rising.
I recently hosted a roundtable discussion in Fredericksburg, and one woman told me her SNAP benefits add up to about $4.50 a day. It’s not much – but it’s a lifeline. Not just for her, but for the grocers, farmers, and communities who benefit from these programs.
This budget is cruel. It hurts people who are already struggling. And it does that so the GOP can hand even more tax breaks to billionaires and massive corporations.
I’m fighting back, but I could use your help to make an impact. Republicans are pushing to get this passed by the end of the month, so we need to raise a public outcry loud enough to get them to listen. Here’s how you can help:
* Call your members of Congress at (202) 224-3121 and tell them you oppose cuts to Medicaid, Social Security, and other vital programs.
* If you have Republican elected officials, this is especially important — they need to hear from you.
* Then, spread the word as far and wide as you can. Talk to your neighbors, post online, write a letter to the editor. The more people speak out, the harder this will be to ignore.
Bottom line: This budget will inflict serious harm on working people while making the rich richer and blowing up the deficit.
If you’re with me in this fight, please sign on now to say NO to the extreme GOP budget. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/-hI2ScNJYE2OEhaobw65DA2]
Democrats may be in the minority, but we don’t get to sit this one out — we need to keep fighting back.
Thanks for standing strong with me.
-Tim Kaine

GOP Rep. Wesley Hunt **[fired back at Democrat Jasmine Crockett](https://substack.com/redirect/e342509b-ed40-4f77-925e-cb7146a9f7dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after she went on an incomprehensible tirade against First Lady Melania Trump, claiming that she did not deserve legal immigrant status in the U.S.
Hunt had something to say...
[Click To Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/e342509b-ed40-4f77-925e-cb7146a9f7dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

"Let me get to what this hearing is supposed to be about," Crockett started. "Melania, the First Lady, a model,... applied for and was given an 'Einstein Visa', and for y'all who don't know, let me tell you how you receive an Einstein Visa; you're supposed to have some sort of significant achievement like winning a Nobel Peace Prize, or a Pulitzer, being an Olympic medalist or having other extraordinary abilities in arts or sciences, business or athletics."
The congresswoman continued, "Last time I checked, the First Lady had none of those accolades under her belt! It doesn't take an Einstein to see the math ain't mathing here!"
**[Hunt answered to her disrespectful remarks,](https://substack.com/redirect/e342509b-ed40-4f77-925e-cb7146a9f7dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** aimed at accusing Republicans of immigration policy hypocrisy, by pointing out the shameless, crystal clear hypocrisy of the Democrats' open borders.
"The faux outrage from the left continues to ignore the damage that has been done to our country and people who are literally maiming fellow Americans while we have done nothing!" Hunt exploded. "We are now behaving in a way that enforces the law! This is not xenophobia, this is the process it takes to enter a sovereign nation."
**["No other country operates this way!](https://substack.com/redirect/e342509b-ed40-4f77-925e-cb7146a9f7dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** There is not a single country in the world that would allow 20 million people to enter their country illegally and then when we do something about it we cry 'xenophobia!'" Hunt continued.

# Lifelong Democrat gets on Trump train after seeing tax deductions in "Big Beautiful Bill"
President Donald Trump recognized James Benson, a third-generation Ford worker from Michigan who **[switched from being a lifelong Democrat to supporting Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/89480bf8-67d6-4fe5-ab1a-057735a4ce39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in 2017 after seeing the benefits of his tax policies.
* **New deduction offers up to $10,000 annually for car loan interest but only for U.S.-made vehicles** \- Trump's "big, beautiful bill" would make interest on car payments fully tax-deductible for cars, trucks, vans, SUVs, and motorcycles that have final assembly occurring in the United States, with Trump emphasizing "if it was made someplace else, we don't care."
* **The benefit phases out for higher earners and has a limited timeframe** \- The deduction would phase out when a taxpayer's modified adjusted gross income exceeds $100,000 and would be in effect for tax years 2025 through 2028, similar to the overtime and tips deduction in Trump's tax package.
* **Trump framed the policy as supporting American manufacturing and workers** \- Speaking from the White House East Room with various trade workers behind him, Trump told the Ford worker "we're going to keep those Michigan auto factories roaring" and emphasized that companies with U.S. plants "are going to make a lot of money" under his policies.

The benefit phases out for higher earners and has a limited timeframe \- The deduction would phase out when a taxpayer's modified adjusted gross income exceeds $100,000 and would be in effect for tax years 2025 through 2028, similar to the overtime and tips deduction in Trump's tax package. Trump framed the policy as supporting American manufacturing and workers \- Speaking from the White House East Room with various trade workers behind him, Trump told the Ford worker "we're going to keep those Michigan auto factories roaring" and emphasized that companies with U.S. plants "are going to make a lot of money" under his policies. body:

Friend,

The Radical Left uses environmentalism as a means of control. They don’t care so much about the environment. They care about controlling your life.

Make no mistake, here’s what the Radical environmentalists want:
* They want you to eat _**BUGS**_ and live in a _**POD**_.
* They want to _**STOP**_ you from having children.
* They'll let _**CHINA**_ have all the power.

The environment should not be an issue that you and I surrender to the Radical Leftists. In fact, conservation is a conservative issue! It’s an issue I am promoting on college campuses and in state capitals nationwide.

I am leading the charge to build the conservative environmental movement. And I’m inviting you, Friend, to join our ranks.

The American Conservation Coalition has over 75,000 conservatives in the fight.

We rival the Sierra Club, but we are NOT Radical Leftists!

Here is my invitation to you:

[By becoming a contributor at $35 or more, my team will send you our exclusive Make America Beautiful Again hat. We have thousands of energetic, young conservatives who promote innovation instead of regulations and market-based solutions to our environmental challenges.

In fact, the environment is the biggest capture point for 18-35 year olds!

_If you believe conservation is a conservative value..._

_If you believe in an “all the above” approach to energy (including nuclear!)..._

_If you believe in leaving a legacy of action over activism to keep America beautiful..._

subject: Yes, the Left wants you to eat BUGS
body:
The environment should not be an issue that you and I surrender to the Radical Leftists.

|

Friend,

The Radical Left uses environmentalism as a means of control. They don’t care so much about the environment. They care about controlling your life.

Make no mistake, here’s what the Radical environmentalists want:
* They want you to eat _**BUGS**_ and live in a _**POD**_.
* They want to _**STOP**_ you from having children.
* They'll let _**CHINA**_ have all the power.

The environment should not be an issue that you and I surrender to the Radical Leftists. In fact, conservation is a conservative issue! It’s an issue I am promoting on college campuses and in state capitals nationwide.

I am leading the charge to build the conservative environmental movement. And I’m inviting you, Friend, to join our ranks.

The American Conservation Coalition has over 75,000 conservatives in the fight.

We rival the Sierra Club, but we are NOT Radical Leftists!

Here is my invitation to you:

[By becoming a contributor at $35 or more, my team will send you our exclusive Make America Beautiful Again hat. I am looking for 100 new contributors to join our ranks today. _Are you in?_](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2znh19o2difvrlkcbnd3smo0uj7f19s8nupmf6cg0_rp22sh2s8i6epb4c1gm1p36c5h2bs)

The American Conservation Coalition was started in 2017 with the mission of changing the narrative around environmental action to build the conservative environmental movement our planet needs.

We have thousands of energetic, young conservatives who promote innovation instead of regulations and market-based solutions to our environmental challenges.

In fact, the environment is the biggest capture point for 18-35 year olds!

_If you believe conservation is a conservative value..._

_If you believe in an “all the above” approach to energy (including nuclear!)..._

_If you believe in leaving a legacy of action over activism to keep America beautiful..._

Then, please, Friend, I strongly urge you to join us today as we build the largest conservative conservation organization in the country.

[I am looking for 100 new contributors to join today. Claim your Make America Beautiful Again Hat by donating $35 or more.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z727449ii6vu121it784vguourht95s1vu73jkkg_rp22sh2s8i6epb4c1gm1p36c5h2bs)

Thank you,

Danielle Franz, CEO

| Peter,
---
As the former Trump Campaign Manager, I was relentlessly ATTACKED on live TV for predicting that President Trump would win the White House.
---
But I didn’t care. Because my commitment will always be to the __truth__. I will always follow the numbers no matter what.
---
_That’s why I sincerely hope you take what I’m about to tell you very seriously._

**And no – I promise you it’s not just another report on the Democrats’ sky-high fundraising numbers. It’s about _real_ polling, _real_ data, and a _real_ trend that could become a big problem if it’s not addressed immediately.**
---
From _Cook Political Report_ : “Republicans just can’t count on Trump’s more peripherally-engaged voters to show up when Trump isn’t on the ballot.
---
So far in 2025, the _partisan intensity gap_ looks awfully similar to the one at this point in 2017.
---
**...across two House special elections...** Democrats have been averaging 63% of Harris’s 2024 vote totals while Republicans have been averaging just 45% of Trump’s.
---
If that pattern were extrapolated across all 435 districts next fall, Democrats would win a whopping 279 seats — 61 more than they need for a majority.”

**I think we can let out a collective sigh of relief that Rep. Elise Stefanik chose to withdraw her nomination for U.N. Ambassador so as not to trigger yet _another_ House special election!**

_Because if we do not... Democrats will have a 279-seat House majority. I cannot even begin to fathom what that would look like._

It’s about CLOSING the “partisan intensity gap.” Because if we do not... Democrats will have a 279-seat House majority. I cannot even begin to fathom what that would look like. When you wake up in the morning and don’t know whether your country is at war or not, that’s chaos.
#
Trump promised to keep us out of war.
Instead, he bombed Iran.
Trump promised he’d never touch Medicaid.
Instead, he’s demanded that Congress cut hundreds of billions of dollars from Medicaid.
Trump promised Veterans that he would always have their back.
Instead, Veterans are seeing their care and the services they depend on disappear. Wait times for appointments and prescriptions have increased exponentially. Food assistance has been cut. VA mortgage support has been cut.
And we’re nowhere close to the end.
This is chaos. When you wake up in the morning and don’t know whether your country is at war or not, that’s chaos. When you don’t know if your health care is going to cover your child’s check up a week from now, that’s chaos. When you’re kicked out of your house because the government pulled the rug out from underneath you, that’s chaos.
This isn’t freedom. It isn’t efficiency. It isn’t greatness. It’s chaos.
But we don’t have to sit here and take it. There’s a path out of this.
We’ve got to buckle down and support the leaders who are combatting this chaos right now. We’ve got to send a message to the GOP that their days are numbered. And we’ve got to power through and defeat MAGA up and down the ballot next year.
VoteVets is doing all three. We ran at 110% all the way through the election last year, and we haven’t stopped.
But that work, at this pace, is tough to keep up. It takes a lot of hours, and a lot of resources. And over the last several months we’ve drawn down our reserves pretty considerably.

Friends -
I gave a speech yesterday on my vision for what I'm calling the Economic War Plan for America – a plan for Democrats to treat America's shrinking middle class as the greatest security threat facing our nation.
This Economic War Plan aims not just to “fix” America's systems or nibble around the margins – but to rebuild it, by ruthlessly focusing on expanding the middle class in America. And, as a Democrat, if we have to slaughter some sacred cows to do so, then so be it.

Scott Brown just announced his campaign in New Hampshire.
| | | It's official:

**Scott Brown just announced he's running to flip New Hampshire's Senate seat red.**

If that name sounds familiar, it's because he's run for Senate — and lost — before. In Massachusetts. Then he ran here, hoping Granite Staters wouldn't notice. But we did.

Now he's back, with support from the national Republican machine, trying to buy his way into the Senate again. It's up to our grassroots team to stop him.

[**Split a $5 contribution now between my campaign and the DSCC and join the fight to beat Scott Brown and win a Democratic Senate majority.**](https://go.dscc.org/go/21818?amount=5&t=4&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FM-20250627-ChrisPappas-PappasScottBrownLaunchTandem-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FM-20250627-ChrisPappas-PappasScottBrownLaunchTandem-Pros-sl1&akid=20623%2E9716520%2Ekegagb)

**This is a serious threat.** The GOP sees New Hampshire as one of their best chances to expand their Senate majority — and they're counting on Scott Brown to help them do it.

_But this seat doesn't belong to Scott Brown._ It belongs to the people of New Hampshire.

I was born and raised here. I've run a family business, represented our communities in Concord and in Congress, and delivered for the people who call this state home — from lowering prescription drug costs to defending reproductive freedom and our democracy.

Scott Brown's record is clear:

❌ He supports Trump's MAGA agenda.
❌ He voted to defund Planned Parenthood.
❌ He opposed marriage equality and the Affordable Care Act.

That's not who we are. And that's not who should represent us.

This race is now one of the most competitive in the country — and the GOP is ready to pour millions into this race to try to win it and expand the Republican Senate majority.

**But we've beaten Scott Brown before. And with your help, we'll do it again.**

Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian. She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_. But today, all that has changed. The president of the American Library Association (ALA) is a self-described “Marxist lesbian.” Radical librarians call _Adventure of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic” _Little House_ series. And they bring men in wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for...”

| | For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA. And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content. Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating “the environment” to a type of religion. The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse. But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.” That may be good for your family – for now. But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values! [**I hope you see why I need your help today.**](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8kE-zmyAUxT8N7nDggqALF0nVLPrahXlNJysHEV9oJRr8N-mn75hxsmFx-J177rnKDZ1tnymSRwRws82IABA7IIDHdXV-_uO-n_BDXK74IX66aPuFbzu6wBu-ayWW9XxtnuePsSzrmf8rfy_0jU_PwbzhPTQ0TtluU2UWNClrG8IDk1IZUcIE4SS4pZJLLSOuW9YawRQwmSSkBeCyJnULJrApEIiIAEl5RDkPG22IiUkrQcSM1xRx8soJlTPeakXHaVXe970Lde-CLr1N0zC-FisQFKPRszehupumnzYCQVF7tRhc9_3fEUHBY6a40gkmIk4wN7zGCUskpkA4SYTUkVDbLFbMk6vGfvbaIJYdsxMu8wsCscnONHZ2iGX5j13Ryg3Kft0Ry_ZGojpmp-pYHi55db4ePj8gyn9VZX6pzp-HEm_P7p2Mdy9fDLJaPQ182gyr7To7Cok4-XodYKu7pPA_AAD__4IvlDo) My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.” I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood. But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian. When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action. So together with a small Christian book publisher aptly named **BRAVE Books** , I wrote “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit. And then we decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with a wholesome Story Hour of our own. Our idea was to read the classic books you and I grew up with plus new wholesome **BRAVE Books** that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism. And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit. >> Over 50 libraries rejected our request to host our Story Hour. >> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep us out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), **BRAVE Books** was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” our supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on. I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end we got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States. And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those Story Hours where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America,” and read wholesome and Godly books. It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part... From there, parents and grandparents started asking **BRAVE Books** how they could host Story Hours of their own. And that’s how our nationwide “See You at the Library Day” was born. Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 360 libraries in 45 states. On the same day, we held hundreds of Story Hours to fill children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God. **I went to as many "See You at the Library" events as I could in one day to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots...** ...for a very simple mission – to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. _And this year, our ambitious goal is to expand “See You at the Library Day” to over 1,000 libraries reaching over 100,000 children._ That day is August 16th, 2025. And what we need is you! It’s going to be expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold Story Hours for 100+ children at each library – that's 100,000+ children in all. **[That’s why I hope you’ll give a sponsorship gift of $125, $250, $375 or more today.](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8kE-zmyAUxT8N7nDggqALF0nVLPrahXlNJysHEV9oJRr8N-mn75hxsmFx-J177rnKDZ1tnymSRwRws82IABA7IIDHdXV-_uO-n_BDXK74IX66aPuFbzu6wBu-ayWW9XxtnuePsSzrmf8rfy_0jU_PwbzhPTQ0TtluU2UWNClrG8IDk1IZUcIE4SS4pZJLLSOuW9YawRQwmSSkBeCyJnULJrApEIiIAEl5RDkPG22IiUkrQcSM1xRx8soJlTPeakXHaVXe970Lde-CLr1N0zC-FisQFKPRszehupumnzYCQVF7tRhc9_3fEUHBY6a40gkmIk4wN7zGCUskpkA4SYTUkVDbLFbMk6vGfvbaIJYdsxMu8wsCscnONHZ2iGX5j13Ryg3Kft0Ry_ZGojpmp-pYHi55db4ePj8gyn9VZX6pzp-HEm_P7p2Mdy9fDLJaPQ182gyr7To7Cok4-XodYKu7pPA_AAD__4IvlDo)** Your sponsorship gift will be used to send a “Story Hour Kit” to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library Day” event. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for the little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. **BRAVE Books** is a small Christian company. They don’t have the millions behind them like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our 1,000 Story Hours to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries. Knowing that, [**please consider a sponsorship gift of $125.**](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8kE-zmyAUxT8N7nDggqALF0nVLPrahXlNJysHEV9oJRr8N-mn75hxsmFx-J177rnKDZ1tnymSRwRws82IABA7IIDHdXV-_uO-n_BDXK74IX66aPuFbzu6wBu-ayWW9XxtnuePsSzrmf8rfy_0jU_PwbzhPTQ0TtluU2UWNClrG8IDk1IZUcIE4SS4pZJLLSOuW9YawRQwmSSkBeCyJnULJrApEIiIAEl5RDkPG22IiUkrQcSM1xRx8soJlTPeakXHaVXe970Lde-CLr1N0zC-FisQFKPRszehupumnzYCQVF7tRhc9_3fEUHBY6a40gkmIk4wN7zGCUskpkA4SYTUkVDbLFbMk6vGfvbaIJYdsxMu8wsCscnONHZ2iGX5j13Ryg3Kft0Ry_ZGojpmp-pYHi55db4ePj8gyn9VZX6pzp-HEm_P7p2Mdy9fDLJaPQ182gyr7To7Cok4-XodYKu7pPA_AAD__4IvlDo) That’s enough to sponsor one entire “Story Hour Kit” yourself. Team: Last year, Congresswoman Marianette Miller-Meeks won reelection in Iowa _by just 0.19 points_ after a recount—the second-closest House race in the country.So what have the opponents of voting rights in Iowa's state legislature done? That's right -- **they just passed a bill lowering the recount threshold to _0.15 points_.** But they made this change across the board, right? To be fair? _Of course not._ Candidates for local elections and the state legislature can still request a recount if their race is within 1% (or 50 votes). For races for Congress and statewide office -- the most competitive races -- the tally must be within 0.15%. **This is yet another case of opponents of voting rights changing the rules to protect themselves and their power.** The law's vote manager claims that this bill was passed to "preserve fairness", while all it really does is protect his political party from potential losses while restricting campaigns from making sure every vote counts. **[Team, chip $25 or whatever you can today as we fight bills like this around the country and protect our right to be heard in our elections>>](https://click.everyaction.com/k/110360081/554094968/1723810624?am=25.00&contactdata=tAIgpWbyRafoHXOhWq2K0aTe9hdgT1AXb9gQmxrXUvfeAbmVDqQtNvwUkVbvkDh7Eb/AsiVKCQOBY8tLKZepGG8XIJx4hxXLGewLXGPQngo=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg5MjE1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjdiMzVkMmY0LTY3NTMtZjAxMS04ZjdjLTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=lMootTfgYvsFgMk2JExoNmJu3o8p4Hz6EnC8xBXY5Tg=&emci=51ef22ff-6453-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=7b35d2f4-6753-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=33603084)**

That's right -- they just passed a bill lowering the recount threshold to 0.15 points. But they made this change across the board, right? To be fair? Of course not. Candidates for local elections and the state legislature can still request a recount if their race is within 1% (or 50 votes). For races for Congress and statewide office -- the most competitive races -- the tally must be within 0.15%. This is yet another case of opponents of voting rights changing the rules to protect themselves and their power. The law's vote manager claims that this bill was passed to "preserve fairness", while all it really does is protect his political party from potential losses while restricting campaigns from making sure every vote counts. If you've saved your payment information with FastAction, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | Those aren't the only changes -- this new law puts partisan county auditors and their staffs in charge of the recount instead of a board chosen by the campaigns in the race. Want to guess which party controls most of Iowa's county auditor positions? Yes, the one that just passed this bill into law.Take it from Iowa state Sen. Sarah Trone Garriott, who has been through two recounts following elections for her Senate seat:"Currently in our process, the county auditor and their staff, they’re very present, they support the process, they’re very engaged ," she said. "But taking out the candidates’ representatives and the neutral party,putting it on a partisan elected official and the staff who are supervised and employed by them does not make it more fair. " It's clear that all this new law does is create opportunities for opponents of voting rights to suppress votes before they can be cast and the controlling party to silence votes after the election by having them tossed in a recount -- just like we saw in North Carolina with a race that was not settled until 6 months after Election Day. | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country. Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities. name: House DFL
subject: Honoring Speaker Emerita Melissa Hortman & Mark Hortman
disclaimer_text: paid for by the
body:
Hello all,
On Saturday, June 14, we all woke to the devastating news that Melissa and Mark Hortman were assassinated in their home. Their golden retriever, Gilbert, was killed too. Senator John Hoffman, along with his wife Yvette and daughter Hope, were also targeted in an assault in their home the same morning by the same suspect. These actions of political violence have shaken us deeply.
Melissa served over 20 years in the House and was our Speaker for six of those years. She was a brilliant and dedicated legislative leader who was passionate about her state, her community, and particularly, her family. While Melissa served in an important position at the State Capitol, she didn’t seek the spotlight. Instead, she was more interested in getting things done to improve the lives of Minnesotans.
Melissa led the most consequential work in our state’s history, guiding us through the COVID-19 pandemic, bringing needed change following the murder of George Floyd, and achieving transformational investments and policy changes to make Minnesota work better for everyone. Rather than taking the credit herself, she worked to empower others to lead and lifted up their work.
Members of the public wishing to pay their respects are invited to the State Capitol rotunda today, Friday, June 27, between noon and 5 p.m. when Melissa and Mark Hortman, along with Gilbert, will lie in state. Melissa will be the first woman and one of fewer than 20 Minnesotans to lie in state in the Capitol.
On Saturday, June 28 at 10:30 a.m., a private funeral will take place. The Minnesota Department of Public Safety will livestream the services on its YouTube channel. [https://www.youtube.com/@MNDPS]
The pain is far-reaching. Everyone who knew Melissa and Mark is hurting. This tragedy is also a loss for everyone who believes in the value of public service and the power of our democracy. We’ve found comfort in the words of Melissa and Mark’s children: Sophie and Colin. While experiencing unthinkable grief, they offered the following suggestions to all of us on how to best honor the memory of their parents:
* Plant a tree.
* Visit a local park and make use of their amenities, especially a bike trail.
* Pet a dog. A golden retriever is ideal, but any will do.
* Tell your loved ones a cheesy dad joke and laugh about it.
* Bake something — bread for Mark or a cake for Melissa, and share it with someone.
* Try a new hobby and enjoy learning something.
* Stand up for what you believe in, especially if that thing is justice and peace.
As we remember Mark and Melissa, we also keep John, Yvette, and Hope Hoffman close in our thoughts, too, and offer wishes for a complete recovery.
Let’s all commit to living up to Melissa’s legacy by relying on kindness, care, love for one another, and love for Minnesota.
Sincerely,
The House DFL
Prepared and paid for by the
DFL House Caucus
255 East Plato Blvd
Saint Paul MN 55107

| Peter, I want to be real with you for a minute. Maxwell and I, our families, and our staff face personal risks every day doing this work. And sometimes people say to me, “Well, that’s what you signed up for.” Last month, the White House came after me for calling out their BS. Last week, MAGA Twitter personalities attacked me with degrading slurs. Next week, it’ll be someone else. There’s something about taking up space in the halls of power as an unapologetic, bald Black woman that really gets under their skin – but I digress. **Their tired playbook is the same as it’s always been. Racist dogwhistles and thinly veiled threats.** And every time this happens, my staff and I face an increase in physical threats. To be clear, no person in any profession – and certainly no public servant – signed up for the vitriol, abuse, harassment, physical threats, and violence that come with this job. No one deserves that. Any rhetoric that creates a permission structure for people to resolve political differences with violence should be vigorously condemned. Y’all know me – I’ll continue to speak up and fight back with every tool available. But I do want to say this:
My team, my colleagues, and I make innumerable personal sacrifices for this movement. We spend more time with each other than we do own families, all because we care about this work. All because we believe in the power and the possibility of a better world and the transformative impact that government can have in our lives.
Every empty attack on me is an attack on all of us. On our families. On our ability to show up and be accessible to constituents in the world every day.
I'm not afraid, I'm not deterred, I won't be silenced. I know that the vile acts of political violence – the attacks on Minnesota lawmakers, the dehumanizing bodyslam of Senator Padilla, the lawless arrest of Congresswoman McIver – were simply because they were doing the jobs they were elected to do.
None of this is happening in a vacuum. This is all coordinated. It is meant to silence us. It is meant to discourage, to dissuade, and to marginalize.

clean_body: | ~ | Peter, I want to be real with you for a minute. Maxwell and I, our families, and our staff face personal risks every day doing this work. And sometimes people say to me, “Well, that’s what you signed up for.” Last month, the White House came after me for calling out their BS. Last week, MAGA Twitter personalities attacked me with degrading slurs. Next week, it’ll be someone else. There’s something about taking up space in the halls of power as an unapologetic, bald Black woman that really gets under their skin – but I digress. Their tired playbook is the same as it’s always been. Racist dogwhistles and thinly veiled threats. And every time this happens, my staff and I face an increase in physical threats. To be clear, no person in any profession – and certainly no public servant – signed up for the vitriol, abuse, harassment, physical threats, and violence that come with this job. No one deserves that. Any rhetoric that creates a permission structure for people to resolve political differences with violence should be vigorously condemned. ~ | ~ Y’all know me – I’ll continue to speak up and fight back with every tool available. But I do want to say this: My team, my colleagues, and I make innumerable personal sacrifices for this movement. We spend more time with each other than we do own families, all because we care about this work. All because we believe in the power and the possibility of a better world and the transformative impact that government can have in our lives. Every empty attack on me is an attack on all of us. On our families. On our ability to show up and be accessible to constituents in the world every day. I'm not afraid, I'm not deterred, I won't be silenced. I know that the vile acts of political violence – the attacks on Minnesota lawmakers, the dehumanizing bodyslam of Senator Padilla, the lawless arrest of Congresswoman McIver – were simply because they were doing the jobs they were elected to do. None of this is happening in a vacuum. This is all coordinated. It is meant to silence us. It is meant to discourage, to dissuade, and to marginalize. Well, we're not backing down. Yesterday, I went live with Simon Rosenberg for a wide-ranging conversation that covered everything from Zohran Mamdani's surprise win in NYC to Donald Trump's faltering approval ratings, the shifting Democratic coalition, and why grit and authenticity matter more than ideology right now.
We opened up with some origin stories--mine starts with the Iraq War and Barack Obama; Simon's goes back to Reagan and Mike Dukakis. From there, we jumped into what Zohran's campaign really tells us (and doesn't tell us) about where the Democratic Party is headed. Spoiler: it's not about being left or center. It's about whether people believe you give a shit.
Simon offered a powerful big-picture take: Trump is weak, and the pro-democracy movement is building something new. He framed this moment as the end of one era (Clinton, Obama, Biden) and the messy but exciting beginning of the next.
We also got into the Iran escalation, the media spin, and how Trump's repeated attempts to project strength are falling flat--with voters, the public, and even our allies overseas. Simon had some sharp analysis on why the American public isn't buying the tough-guy routine anymore, and how that shift is showing up in the polling.
If you care about how we fight back--and win--against Trump and authoritarianism, this is a conversation you don't want to miss. We talked digital organizing, messaging strategy, and what it means to show up with heart and conviction in 2025 and beyond.

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. ## My fourth of July wish...
For the last few months, the lion's share of Congress's energy has been put towards passing Trump's big, beautiful bill.
But between foreign missile strikes and the NATO summit, the bill has taken a bit of a backseat in the news cycle.
So where does it stand?
It hasn't been an easy road but it looks like there might finally be some light at the end of the tunnel.
Voting starts today, and Senate Majority Leader John Thune is confident that the bill will be passed by the 4th of July.
I, for one, think that's the best Independence Day present any of us could get.
The problem is, there's been so much talk and controversy around the bill, it's hard to know what's really in it.
Even on the Right, there's been significant disagreement about whether it's good legislation or not.
That's why I want to take an in depth look at the reality of the bill - and why it's a crucial next step towards making America great again.
Let's break it down... what does the big, beautiful bill REALLY do?...

Marrying John was one of the happiest days of my life, second only to the day marriage equality became legal for our entire country.
| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110367225/554115940/-1071797536?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk48-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmN2E2NWI3Ni03MDUzLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=owHOgoFR_mfqPLa-b00jbQmqj013mfur6Q3gBqfhwIg=)

Ten years ago yesterday, I was sitting in the Supreme Court fighting for my husband, John, and for queer couples like us across the nation.

**[Before sharing our story, I ask that you chip in to Equality Ohio and Dignity of Work PAC to help protect our freedoms.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110367228/554115942/-1071797536?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk48-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmN2E2NWI3Ni03MDUzLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=owHOgoFR_mfqPLa-b00jbQmqj013mfur6Q3gBqfhwIg=)**
After ALS stole almost all of his physical abilities, I became John’s caretaker. After all, that’s what you do when you love someone. We began at-home hospice care out of concern over how John would be treated as an out gay man in a hospice facility. Even if we had been married, would they recognize me as his spouse in a healthcare setting?

We had wanted to get married since the mid-1990s, but it became especially important to us as he neared the end of his life. Because marriage equality was not legal in Ohio, we flew to Maryland within two weeks of the Windsor decision striking down the federal Defense of Marriage Act. The day I took John’s hand in mine and we got married on the tarmac of a Maryland airport, was the happiest day of our life together.
When we discovered the State of Ohio would refuse to list John as married or recognize me as John’s surviving spouse on his death certificate at the time he died, we started the fight that eventually became the Supreme Court case Obergefell v. Hodges. Although John died before our historic win, seeing how marriage equality has changed so many lives reminds me of him daily.

**Sadly, the right to marriage we fought for is under attack, again.**

Ten years later, anti-equality forces are attacking our rights like never before. In fact, they’re passing state laws and resolutions, trying to get the Supreme Court to overturn marriage equality.
**[Please split a donation between Equality Ohio and Dignity of Work PAC to make sure we can keep fighting back.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110367229/554115944/-1071797536?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk48-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmN2E2NWI3Ni03MDUzLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=owHOgoFR_mfqPLa-b00jbQmqj013mfur6Q3gBqfhwIg=)**
