**You don’t have to take it from me. Just this year, the Idaho House passed a resolution urging the U.S. Supreme Court to reconsider the Obergefell decision.** Just a few months ago, the North Dakota House passed a similar bill. Supreme Court justices have also made it clear they want to overturn Obergefell and other decisions.

Even worse are the attacks on the transgender community, including in my home of Ohio, where transgender youth are subjected to a forced outing law, even when doing so puts them at risk of abuse at home.
I was lucky to love John, and our willingness to fight for each other – and our relationship – helped make the world a better place. I couldn’t have done it without more than thirty other plaintiffs and the attorneys who were part of Obergefell v. Hodges. It was a group effort, and that’s why we need your help today.

**[Will you split a donation between Equality Ohio and Dignity of Work PAC to stand with me and defend LGBTQ+ Equality?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110367234/554115951/-1071797536?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk48-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmN2E2NWI3Ni03MDUzLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=owHOgoFR_mfqPLa-b00jbQmqj013mfur6Q3gBqfhwIg=)**
We won because our community refused anything less than equality. We refused to live in a world where birth and death certificates could ignore our lawful marriages. We refused to live in a world where we were unable to say “I do” to the person we love.

Today, we refuse to live in a world where birth certificates are weaponized to deny our gender identity. We refuse to live in a world where a loving parent cannot make healthcare decisions for their child. It’s time for us to demand equality and justice again.
We know what life was like before, and we are NOT going back.

This time, I hope you’ll join me and commit to protecting our right to not only love, but to exist.

Love first, and always,
Jim

America's descent into madness continues to accelerate. Many of us incensed by the Trump administration's mendacity, and the [horrifying complicity of Democrats](https://substack.com/redirect/4b0d622e-f406-49ed-ab6c-df83571e6a40?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) who helped put him in office before enabling his agenda and appointments, might find some solace in an emergent pattern repeating itself in policy areas including international trade, immigration, and war.
One hopes the press and international community might finally learn something from it--but I would not counsel anyone to hold their breath. If nothing else, I'm grateful that one of the many concerns I've raised in this column appears to have been heard, and that the administration walked back one of its signature policies after hearing other voices share it.
_Thanks for reading Chronicles of a Dying Empire! You can help inform your friends by sharing this post._
[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=166986286&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTY2OTg2Mjg2LCJpYXQiOjE3NTEwNDE0MzgsImV4cCI6MTc1MzYzMzQzOCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.xicIqUDOXN6cJzSAak2F7YsQs2N1LZW_fUqm4jeSSD8)
### **Immigrant scapegoats**
For years, scapegoating immigrants has been an integral part of the president's personal brand. He has incited violence in communities reeling from mass shootings, like El Paso, Texas. He has spread false rumors about immigrant communities repudiated even by fellow Republicans, such as those in Ohio responding to his lies about Haitian immigrants supposedly eating pets.
His use of divisive lies, however, is far from Trump's only action aiming to build his own power by demonizing immigrants. After the outrageous examples above, he sparked a more recent witch hunt targeting immigrant communities across the country. He ordered federal officials to arrest undocumented Americans even at courthouses, and to go far beyond his rhetorical focus on immigrants who commit crimes to include those simply looking for work.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4c47060a-6547-40db-bc08-15471f62dd81?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Even non-immigrant citizens are at risk. As his policies grew increasingly controversial, the president effectively [invaded](https://substack.com/redirect/74ed588b-5f2a-4f70-8564-8780a1eff362?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the union's most populous and prosperous state with federal shock troops deployed to violently suppress even citizens invoking their constitutional [rights to dissent](https://substack.com/redirect/81c3aacb-a5f5-4af5-9285-fc88b13be0b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
I--and many others--have written about the [predictable results](https://substack.com/redirect/008ca1f3-e8a0-40f7-bf80-e2911cac348d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of a policy dividing communities, deporting essential workers, and splitting families apart. Never has there been any plausible case that any of these results would help American workers, as we continue to suffer under the economic predation of businesses supported and enabled by both major political parties.
Yet, after ignoring pleas for rationality, or recognition of international rights steamrolled by ICE agents acting like a gestapo around the country, the administration suddenly [reversed course](https://substack.com/redirect/7e5f4ef8-5587-40f3-a106-51c637b9fc4e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) recently, announcing that it would no longer deploy ICE agents to raid businesses including farms and restaurants. Those were two of the critical industries I identified in an earlier column explaining some of the ways in which Trump policies are destroying America's economy.
I've started another post in that series that I hope to publish at some point, although current events have overtaken that vision and forced me to write on these other subjects first.
For now, the point is that advocates for immigrant rights can celebrate a hard fought victory, even as we recognize a pattern of institutional mania and foolishness.
_Chronicles of a Dying Empire is a publication supported by readers, rather than advertisers.**To receive new posts, sign up for a free subscription!** To support my work, please consider becoming a paid subscriber._
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..mbogvqlXWfUCY44TsCAJNkVYqzOXnIm_qzB3lhtzv_k?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=166986286)
### **Wielding executive power based on whims**
Trump adopted his immigration policy based on a political strategy aiming to curry favor with rural & working class communities, only to reverse course once those same communities expressed their alarm at the results that many of us saw coming. After all, until Los Angeles was recently invaded by ICE agents and U.S. Marines deployed to quell constitutionally protected dissent supporting human rights, it was MAGA-supporting regions that suffered the worst under Trump's policies.
This pattern reveals the instability of governing according to opinions, ignoring facts and analysis. Trump boasted about his witch hunt, ignoring that immigrants are the economic backbone of many communities that have suffered as their workers (and their families' breadwinners) have been detained or deported. Once the results became clear to his rural supporters, their voices more or less forced Trump to reconsider.
That is not a rational pattern. It is one revealing institutional ignorance responding only to the whims of MAGA supporters (and their [enablers](https://substack.com/redirect/8179450c-cf69-4301-9887-a911bf3daf47?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the Democratic Party) who have repeatedly revealed themselves to be more interested in lies and misrepresentations than anything resembling reality.
Beyond the flip-flop on immigration enforcement, and the continuing demonization of immigrants within the limits of the administration's new policy, two aspects of the pattern especially warrant attention.
First is its sheer irrationality. It would be nice to imagine that the world's greatest superpower has at least the deliberative capacity of the average American family, but it's clear that it sadly has less than the average patient at a mental institution.
There is no reason or sanity driving federal policy in any arena. The entire landscape is driven by changing whims. It reflects neither democracy nor true autocracy, so much as institutional insanity.

### **What constitutional rights?**
Second, despite all of the president's [rhetoric](https://substack.com/redirect/3750d063-8f0a-4319-ac7f-b2081a4a6050?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about supposedly protecting "free speech," it is quite clear that this administration and its supporters understand nothing of it.
That ignorance is no less outrageous just because [the same can be said of every Democratic president over the past generation](https://substack.com/redirect/a987a8e8-34a1-4c9a-b648-5c38b361da8b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). What that bipartisan failure ultimately indicates is a country that has lost any awareness of its own founding ideals, one making major collective decisions based on irrational hunches ignoring facts and reality.
This is far from the first time we have seen the U.S.--not just a tacky president who has failed upwards his entire life--reveal this unfortunately widely shared and sadly recurring mania.

## What’s the big deal about Ethnic Studies? Oppressed versus Oppressor
---
Peter Ohtaki — June 26, 2025
---
|
---
“The San Mateo Union High School District recently held a series of study sessions on ethnic studies. It was alarming that only one worksheet references the contributions and accomplishments of ethnic groups — the key stated intent of ethnic studies. However, in stark contrast, the **overwhelming majority of the content focuses on oppression, colonization, resistance and hegemony**. This reinforces the concerns of parents that there is a significant void between the stated intent (the what) of the curriculum and how it’s being implemented,” wrote Dan Torunian in a letter to the editor of the _San Mateo Daily Journal_ April 19.We emailed the Sequoia Union High School District (SUHSD) Board on April 23, “As parents of 3 M-A teenagers, we’re very concerned about Ethnic Studies Curriculum teaching our kids U.S. history through the lens of [**oppressed versus oppressor**](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=685ec5d8daacfb767aa2d064&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mainstreamrevolution.com%2Fblog%2F2019%2F4-27%2Fethnicstudiesgaza%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D685e3cb6071f95633b9c5521%26ss_email_id%3D685ec5d8daacfb767aa2d064%26ss_campaign_name%3DWhat%25E2%2580%2599s%2Bthe%2Bbig%2Bdeal%2Babout%2BEthnic%2BStudies%253F%2BOppressed%2Bversus%2BOppressor%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2025-06-27T16%253A25%253A13Z&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_685e3cb6071f95633b9c5521&l=en-US&s=9kpV8geRKbHyZ7BEiJNCqJQ1sMk%3D)**,** which divides our communities rather than celebrating the journeys of immigrants who have overcome discrimination.Unit 1 examines both dominant and counter-narratives. Last year, our youngest son as a Freshman was in the Israel-Gaza lesson, controversial among M-A families due to its one-sided presentation of the conflict to teach the ‘Counter-narrative’ of the Palestinians, and **taught our son that Israel and the U.S. are oppressors**. District and State policy is for both sides to be taught on controversial issues. How will the Board and our Community be assured this policy is followed in this ethnic studies curriculum?”In November 2023, we were appalled after downloading the one-sided Israel-Gaza war slides, as it didn’t mention Hamas is a terrorist organization nor Iran’s role as the Middle East’s bully, both intent on the destruction of Israel. The slides went viral among families resulting in a lawsuit against the SUHSD over antisemitism.**Ethnic studies: Clarifying the debate** Dan Torunian wrote, “As with every nation, our nation’s history is complex. The intention of high school ethnic studies would seem to support that premise as one cannot excuse history, but one cannot erase it either. What we can do, is learn from history and apply those learnings in our aspiration **to create a more perfect union**.We wrote to the SUHSD, “There’s no mention on this slide of the Civil War, Emancipation Proclamation and 14th Amendment, Brown vs BOE, Civil Rights Act, and efforts by this country to correct its slavery past.There’s no mention of the strategies utilized by other ethnic groups - Asians, Jews, Irish and Italians when first arriving in America to overcome discrimination. My father was forced into the Manzanar internment camp during WWII, and like other Japanese-Americans proved their loyalty by joining the U.S. Army.We want our kids to be taught HOW to think, not WHAT to think.”**What are the Consequences?** On January 23, Palo Alto Unified School District Board member Rowena Chiu was [attacked for her concern](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=685ec5d8daacfb767aa2d064&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsfstandard.com%2F2025%2F02%2F11%2Fshe-survived-harvey-weinstein-can-she-survive-controversy-on-a-silicon-valley-school-board%2F&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_685e3cb6071f95633b9c5521&l=en-US&s=IKS7GTFtI49qEBpgvK5Zo17yHKk%3D) raised by parents that Ethnic Studies will divide the community into ‘oppressed’ and ‘oppressors’. The teachers union asked the San Mateo Union High School District to censure Trustee Jennifer Jacobson for her [comments made at on Ethnic Studies forum](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=685ec5d8daacfb767aa2d064&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.smdailyjournal.com%2Fnews%2Flocal%2Fteachers-union-seeks-censure-of-san-mateo-union-high-school-district-trustee%2Farticle_03da3bb4-fb09-11ef-9fce-2feb3a5a6f0a.html&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_685e3cb6071f95633b9c5521&l=en-US&s=8-tLwZ6eLxR6o_36_ZoiqZCPR2M%3D) hosted by the Israeli-American Civic Action Network on February 26.Protestors in Los Angeles recently carried not only Mexican but also Palestinian flags, while throwing rocks and Molotov cocktails at ICE, Waymo cars, and burning the American flag. Pro-Palestinian protests shut down major universities across the country in 2024, and protestors chanted “From the River to the Sea” or “Globalize the Intifada” not knowing those slogans call for the extermination of Israel. **Some who consider themselves Oppressed (called** _[**appropriated racial oppression**](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=685ec5d8daacfb767aa2d064&u=https%3A%2F%2Frrapp.spia.princeton.edu%2Fshifting-focus-from-internalization-to-appropriation-of-racial-oppression%2F&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_685e3cb6071f95633b9c5521&l=en-US&s=lhBtn7uHrQTWw64XncQKXrgAtj8%3D)_**) justify violence against those they perceive as Oppressors:**
* Luigi Mangione, a UPenn grad, murdered the United Healthcare CEO Brian Thompson
* Elias Rodriguez from Chicago killed 2 Israeli embassy employees - a couple about to be engaged - shouting “I did it for Palestine, I did it for Gaza!”

**What can you do?**
1. Download your kids’ Ethnic Studies curriculum - Ethnic Studies is required for all California high school students starting 2026.
2. Join a non-PTA parents group, such as SUHSD Students First.
3. Lobby your state representatives to change the _[CA Model Curriculum for Ethnic Studies](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=685ec5d8daacfb767aa2d064&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cde.ca.gov%2Fci%2Fcr%2Fcf%2Fesmc.asp&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_685e3cb6071f95633b9c5521&l=en-US&s=VkFXS-C6G_t632rjHi_GESlCWA0%3D)_.
4. Run for school board.

On Memorial Day, I took my kids to my father and uncle’s gravesites at the National Cemetery in San Bruno who served in the U.S. Army Military Intelligence Service (MIS) in WWII and put my flag up. We must remember the “greatest” generation defended our country during World War II and Korea, Baby Boomers in Vietnam, and the soldiers of all colors who fought in the post-9/11 War on Terror.

President Trump has taken bold action to protect American lives, secure our borders, and put our country first. Jon Ossoff hasn’t been with him any step of the way.

_Ossoff stood by while Biden opened our borders and was nowhere to be found when it mattered most during Afghanistan’s collapse._ Since the election, all he’s done is vote against supporting Israel and protecting girls’ sports.

_And by the way, he’s also said he’d support impeaching President Trump._

**Jon Ossoff is a politician who only cares about optics and keeping the party bosses happy. We can, and we must, do better than that. And I can do better than him.**

name: Marjorie Taylor Greene
subject: Mark Levin
body:
I am livid.

| | | | |
---
Dear patriot, I am livid.
Fox News’ #1 Neocon, Mark Levin, called me a “shameless nitwit” on X for opposing a war with Iran, a foreign war that betrays the MAGA promise of NO MORE FOREIGN WARS. Levin even posted threatening language, saying I’m “on his radar” - language that echoes the death threats I receive daily.
**__[It’s sick, it’s disturbing, and it’s exactly why I need you in my corner](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aIO5/?__vbtrk=Mjk5Mjk4OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjk5Mjk4OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_._**
Other Neocons and RINOs are piling on, attacking me by name because I dare to put America First and speak out against a reckless war with Iran that could lead to World War III.
**Thankfully, President Trump quickly ended the war with a tremendous effort towards peace, but that will never satisfy Neocons like Mark Levin, who only wants more war and American troops on the ground.**
_**_[That’s why I’m reaching out with an urgent request](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aIO5/?__vbtrk=Mjk5Mjk4OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjk5Mjk4OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_.**_
Friend, my end-of-quarter fundraising deadline is June 30 at midnight, and I need your support to keep standing strong against the RINOs, Neocons, and warmongers who are coming after me with everything they’ve got!
[DONATE NOW](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aIO5/?__vbtrk=Mjk5Mjk4OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjk5Mjk4OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
I’ve spent millions of my own money and traveled this great nation campaigning for President Trump and our MAGA agenda: secure borders, safe communities, and peace - not regime change or endless wars for the military-industrial complex. But the Neocon suck-ups like Levin, a vocal NeverTrumper, are trying to silence me and fracture our movement.
**__[They’re even funding primary challenges against me](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aIO5/?__vbtrk=Mjk5Mjk4OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjk5Mjk4OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)__ _._**
This is the biggest political fight of my life, and I can’t do it alone. Your generous donation before the June 30 midnight deadline will send a message to these warmongers that the American people stand with me and our America First values. Every dollar helps me fight back against the RINOs, Neocons, and their propaganda machine at Fox News.
[DONATE NOW](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aIO5/?__vbtrk=Mjk5Mjk4OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjk5Mjk4OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
I’m fighting for a future where our kids - my own Gen Z children included - can afford homes, live free, and not be burdened by foreign wars or a $37 trillion national debt. I’m sick of watching our brave troops and tax dollars wasted on conflicts that don’t benefit America. That’s why I’m standing firm, even when it means taking heat from the establishment.
**Together, we can show Levin and his Neocon buddies that MAGA is stronger than ever.**
_**[Please, chip in before the clock strikes midnight on June 3 0](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aIO5/?__vbtrk=Mjk5Mjk4OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjk5Mjk4OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct).**_
Let’s keep America First!
_For God, Country, and Freedom,_
[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aIO5/?__vbtrk=Mjk5Mjk4OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjk5Mjk4OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)

body:
Last week, I met with Lelo Juarez and exercised my congressional oversight authority to tour the privately run ICE detention facility in Tacoma.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110374110/554136357/-201694504?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YmM0M2FkOC03ODUzLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=H--rzpiXKfUvLMao-vmXUHqr7--pWHyNUKHeIsfokH0=&emci=8b555f62-7350-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=7bc43ad8-7853-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=9494239)
---

| | **Last week, I exercised my congressional oversight authority to tour the privately run ICE detention facility in Tacoma.** I took a basic tour, during which I saw the kitchen, the law library, medical facilities, and housing pods. More than 1,500 people are currently detained in the Tacoma facility — that is more than twice as many as at the start of the year. **The facility is understaffed and can not sufficiently provide basic services to the people being held there.** **I do not approve of President Trump's policy to arrest 3,000 people a day for detention, and it is only exacerbating the problems arising from understaffing.** After the tour, I met with Alfredo Juarez Zeferino, known to the community as Lelo, a Northwest Washington community member who has been detained since March. Lelo is an activist, a union leader, and a husband. Lelo seemed resilient and hopeful, but being in the detention center has taken a toll on him. He shared his experiences from the facility, and I shared with him that many people in Northwest Washington, beyond his family and friends, have been urging me to meet with him. **I shared with him how Skagit County and the broader Northwest Washington community have rallied around him to fight for his future.** **He asked for my help to be able to visit with his family, and I am working to make that possible.** I will continue to work with Representative Jayapal, Ranking Member of the Subcommittee on Immigration Integrity, Security, and Enforcement, to ensure people detained by ICE receive basic services and have the opportunity to exercise their constitutional rights. More soon, _Rick_ |

clean_body: Last week, I met with Lelo Juarez and exercised my congressional oversight authority to tour the privately run ICE detention facility in Tacoma. | | | | Last week, I exercised my congressional oversight authority to tour the privately run ICE detention facility in Tacoma. I took a basic tour, during which I saw the kitchen, the law library, medical facilities, and housing pods. More than 1,500 people are currently detained in the Tacoma facility — that is more than twice as many as at the start of the year. The facility is understaffed and can not sufficiently provide basic services to the people being held there. I do not approve of President Trump's policy to arrest 3,000 people a day for detention, and it is only exacerbating the problems arising from understaffing. After the tour, I met with Alfredo Juarez Zeferino, known to the community as Lelo, a Northwest Washington community member who has been detained since March. Lelo is an activist, a union leader, and a husband. Lelo seemed resilient and hopeful, but being in the detention center has taken a toll on him. He shared his experiences from the facility, and I shared with him that many people in Northwest Washington, beyond his family and friends, have been urging me to meet with him. I shared with him how Skagit County and the broader Northwest Washington community have rallied around him to fight for his future. He asked for my help to be able to visit with his family, and I am working to make that possible. I will continue to work with Representative Jayapal, Ranking Member of the Subcommittee on Immigration Integrity, Security, and Enforcement, to ensure people detained by ICE receive basic services and have the opportunity to exercise their constitutional rights. Where else but the United States could a girl leave home at the age of 17, put herself through college, become the first female Mayor of her hometown, and then be asked to serve America in a presidential administration? Beth Van Duyne is running for Congress because she knows the people of the 24th District deserve to have a strong, principled voice in Congress. She's been asked what prompted her to run for public office; the answer is simple – her children. We live in a very fragile time for our nation, our families, and the future of the American Dream. Socialism is on the rise, our border crisis has never been worse, and we face constant threats from hostile nations willing to use cyber-attacks, nuclear weapons, and terrorist jihad. When Beth thinks about her two children, she wants them to have the same opportunities in life that she did; She wants them to be able to grow up safe and proud of our country. Beth is a single mom, a conservative Republican, a reformer who has defeated government corruption, a believer in the rule of law who has helped remove thousands of criminal aliens from North Texas, a leader who helped deliver growth and new job opportunities, and a Constitutionalist who has never backed down when it comes to protecting the rights of all North Texans. | PAID FOR BY BETH VAN DUYNE FOR CONGRESS

body:
#

Peter, we’ve got our next official FEC deadline of the year on Monday. Hits at midnight.
That deadline comes at a moment unlike any other in our nation’s history.
I served in Iraq as a Marine at the height of the war, about 20 years ago. All those years ago, I never thought I’d see a president as lawless as this one. I never thought I’d see the President of the United States blatantly ignore the Supreme Court. I signed up to serve to defend our Constitution — to make sure exactly that kind of thing never happened at home.
This is authoritarianism. It is here. And we need to stand up now or risk losing the rights and liberties we were born with.
You know what’s happening, but most people still don’t. If we’re going to build a movement that stops and reverses Trump’s power grab, we have to start reaching people anywhere they are.
That’s why I’m getting on cable news all the time. It’s why I’m doing podcasts and social media, interviews with local and national papers. It’s why I’m doing town halls all over the country, and why I hope to do more soon.
That’s what I did in my campaign. It’s what I’ve been doing since I got elected. And I’m going to keep doing it as long as I have to until we start to break through to people.

Donald Trump wants to cut off funding for public broadcasting in order to help fund his tax cuts for billionaires.
**[I’m speaking out and fighting for this vital funding. Millions of Americans — including children — count on programs like NPR and PBS for educational, informative content. If you stand opposed to these cuts, add your name alongside mine today.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1023?c0=engagement-202506-npr-pbs.7BRK32&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_GEN_AC90_20250627_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=8724%2E5257348%2Et3qpmq)**

If Trump had his way, Congress would outright cancel funding for the Corporation for Public Broadcasting, which funds NPR and PBS.
[](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1023?c0=engagement-202506-npr-pbs.7BRK32&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_GEN_AC90_20250627_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=6&akid=8724%2E5257348%2Et3qpmq)

These cuts would mean children won’t be able to access educational programming that kids have enjoyed for decades. Sesame Street is such quality programming — every child should be able to watch these programs, regardless of their zip code or income level.
These cuts are another part of the DOGE playbook: Terminating funding for programs that millions of Americans count on, all while the richest in the country get another tax cut.

Peter —

You’ve probably seen this term in the headlines: **"Toss-Up.”** But what does that actually mean? Is it just another piece of political jargon tossed around by pundits?

Let us break it down for you.

A Toss-Up race means nobody has a clear advantage. Not the incumbent or the challenger. The outcome is totally up in the air, and every single dollar, door knock, and phone call matters. **IA-01 is a true Toss-Up in 2025 because...**

❌ **Mariannette Miller-Meeks is a terrible leader.** Over the past few months, she’s made it her mission to ignore what Iowans actually need and instead follow every marching order from her party elites. It’s not a mystery why 1/3 of her constituents are dissatisfied with the job she’s doing — _she’s not doing it for them._

❌ **Our performance in 2024 was incredible.** Iowa’s 1st District is one of the most competitive races in the entire country because of the hard work and dedication of this grassroots team. Our race was decided by less than half a percentage point. That’s a margin smaller than the crowd at a high school basketball game. And in 2026, it's shaping up to be just as close — if not closer.

❌ **Democrats only need a net gain of three seats to flip the House.** That’s it. Three. And IA-01 is squarely in the spotlight. In fact, _Roll Call_ recently called Miller-Meeks “vulnerable,” and she's at the top of the list of Republicans we have a real shot at defeating.

This race is putting Iowa on the national map — and for good reason. What happens here could determine who controls Congress and, more importantly, whether the voices and values of everyday Iowans are finally heard in Washington.

But Republicans won’t give this seat up easily. Speaker Mike Johnson himself is invested in keeping this seat red – **he just cut Miller-Meeks a $123,000 check to help her salvage her campaign against us!**

It’s crucial we come out strong on our first FEC report. Mike Johnson and Mariannette Miller-Meeks will both be checking to see if we have enough strength to combat their dark money schemes – we have to prove to them that we have what it takes to keep pace. Your support will prove we have a grassroots team strong enough to flip this seat.

Is it just another piece of political jargon tossed around by pundits? Let us break it down for you. A Toss-Up race means nobody has a clear advantage. Not the incumbent or the challenger. The outcome is totally up in the air, and every single dollar, door knock, and phone call matters. IA-01 is a true Toss-Up in 2025 because... ❌ Mariannette Miller-Meeks is a terrible leader. Over the past few months, she’s made it her mission to ignore what Iowans actually need and instead follow every marching order from her party elites. It’s not a mystery why 1/3 of her constituents are dissatisfied with the job she’s doing — she’s not doing it for them. ❌ Our performance in 2024 was incredible. Iowa’s 1st District is one of the most competitive races in the entire country because of the hard work and dedication of this grassroots team. Our race was decided by less than half a percentage point. That’s a margin smaller than the crowd at a high school basketball game. And in 2026, it's shaping up to be just as close — if not closer. ❌ Democrats only need a net gain of three seats to flip the House. That’s it. Three. And IA-01 is squarely in the spotlight. In fact, Roll Call recently called Miller-Meeks “vulnerable,” and she's at the top of the list of Republicans we have a real shot at defeating. This race is putting Iowa on the national map — and for good reason. What happens here could determine who controls Congress and, more importantly, whether the voices and values of everyday Iowans are finally heard in Washington. But Republicans won’t give this seat up easily. Speaker Mike Johnson himself is invested in keeping this seat red – he just cut Miller-Meeks a $123,000 check to help her salvage her campaign against us! It’s crucial we come out strong on our first FEC report. Mike Johnson and Mariannette Miller-Meeks will both be checking to see if we have enough strength to combat their dark money schemes – we have to prove to them that we have what it takes to keep pace. subject: Holding Big Pharma accountable

body:
Peter,

Even among the other heartless people who fueled the opioid epidemic, the Sackler family and Purdue Pharma stand out for their greed and callous disregard for human life. My blood boils when I think about how they lined their pockets by aggressively pushing opioids and deliberately downplaying their addictiveness.

No amount of money can undo the suffering they’ve caused, but it’s still important to hold these bad actors accountable.

That’s why I joined 55 other attorneys general this week in signing onto a $7.4 billion settlement that ends the Sacklers’ control of Purdue Pharma and bans them from selling opioids in the United States.

Minnesota will receive about $59 million from this settlement—the largest ever reached with the individuals behind the opioid crisis. These funds will be used for treatment, prevention, and harm reduction strategies and programs across the state.

As the People’s Lawyer, I will always stand up to powerful special interests that prioritize profits, not people. But victories like this aren’t possible without your support.

Our campaign’s end-of-quarter fundraising deadline is just days away, but we’re still $17,375 short of our goal. We need your help to make up the difference.

Peter, will you give $10, $25, $50, or whatever you can to support our campaign?

disclaimer_text: Paid for by In This Together PAC
body:
Andy Beshear knows how to win tough elections — because he’s won three statewide races as a Democrat in deep-red Kentucky.
Peter,

Andy Beshear knows how to win tough elections — _because he’s won three statewide races as a Democrat in deep-red Kentucky._

And now, he’s making sure Democrats across the country know how to do it too. At a gathering with Florida Democrats this past weekend, Andy laid out the four-part blueprint that helped him flip red counties and win statewide in a tough environment:

1️⃣ **Focus on people’s daily lives.** Talk about the issues families feel every day — jobs, schools, public safety, and healthcare. That’s the lane Democrats need to own.

2️⃣ **Talk like a real person.** Skip the sanitized language. People who are going through recovery use the word addiction, not substance use disorder. People who don’t have enough to pay for food say they are hungry, not food insecure. Connect from the heart.

3️⃣ **Get dirt on your boots.** Show up in every community. It isn’t enough to hold a bill-signing ceremony — be there when factories open, when new schools break ground, and where families gather.

4️⃣ **Explain your why.** Voters need to hear the values behind your decisions. For Andy, that means he leads with his faith. Every good candidate should lead with what drives them and needs to communicate that to voters.

It’s a strategy built on listening, focusing on fixing the challenges in people’s everyday lives, fighting to protect people’s basic rights, and refusing to write off any voter.

Andy’s sharing this plan because it works, and because he knows the stakes couldn’t be higher. At In This Together PAC, we’re making sure candidates who embrace this blueprint have the resources they need to win.

Let me start here: The fight
against Donald Trump’s unlawful and anti-democratic order eliminating
birthright citizenship is far from over.

When the President signed an executive order tossing out birthright
citizenship on day 1 of his second term, I sued him within hours and
secured a nationwide injunction blocking its implementation. Today, the
Supreme Court sent consideration of nationwide injunctions back to the
lower courts — and I’m hopeful the courts will recognize that a patchwork
of state-by-state injunctions would create chaos and harm across the
country.

Bottom line: The rights guaranteed by the U.S. Constitution shouldn’t
depend on what state you live in — they belong to all of us.

We’re a nation of immigrants and California is a state of immigrants,
including my own mom who came to California from the Philippines.
Immigrants make our state and nation great, and I’ll always stand up for
their rights and protections.

Now more than ever before, we can’t let up in the fight against the
anti-democratic forces trying to divide us and roll back our
constitutional rights — so I’m asking for your help to power this work
before our June 30 filing deadline.

going.

Thank you so much. More to come.

Rob

clean_body: This only works when we all show up | Our biggest fundraising deadline of the year so far is in just three days, so we’ll cut straight to it: We’ve set an ambitious $75,000 fundraising goal to hit by midnight on Monday, and we’re asking our most dedicated supporters to chip in $1 toward that goal. = | = We know what you're thinking: How can $1 possibly make a dent in this fight when we're up against Big Oil's billions and an administration hellbent on doing the fossil fuel industry’s bidding? See, it’s not just your $1 donation. It's $1 from thousands of people like you who understand the stakes of the climate crisis and refuse to let fossil fuel billionaires silence us. $1 donations are how we helped elect nearly 100 climate champions in high-stakes races around the country in 2024 — and just this month, they gave us the fuel to win a tough primary in Virginia’s Attorney General race where we challenged a Democrat who accepted a staggering $800,000 from the state’s largest corporate polluter. $1 at a time is how we build a firewall of down-ballot leaders at the state and local level to protect our communities from Trump's willful ignorance of the climate emergency — an ignorance made even more dangerous as record-breaking heat waves sweep the East Coast and put millions of lives at risk. So if you've ever wondered whether your donation can make a difference, here's your answer: Yes. = = = We appreciate your support, Team JanePAC P.S. If you’ve already chipped in toward our end-of-quarter fundraising push, thank you so much for your support! It may take a few days for our records to update. subject: This is a time for courage
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
If the last six months have shown us anything, it’s that we need leaders with the resolve to stand up to him.
#

Team,
We’re coming up on the six-month mark of Donald Trump’s second term. If the last six months have shown us anything, it’s that we need leaders with the resolve to stand up to him.
Many are taking a step back. They hope to ride this out, wait for better times, and avoid the wrath of Trump and his donors. They’re free to do that.
But it takes courage to continue this work. Especially at a time when every part of the Trump Administration is deadset on retribution and vengeance. When some of the richest and most powerful people in the world are lining up against you. When you're under relentless pressure every day from the MAGA Right.
Mark is standing in the way. And he deserves our support.
June 30th isn’t just our next FEC fundraising deadline. It marks the midpoint of 2025 — and it’s an important bellwether for how things are going to go in the elections next year.
After midnight on Monday, Mark is legally required to report how much money he’s raised, and how many supporters have chipped in. That report is going to show people what we are capable of, and it just might show Trump and all his lackeys that there are a lot of Americans who are standing up alongside Mark.
[**Please, if you can, chip in $3 to Mark’s campaign so we can close the gap and hit our goals ahead of Monday’s deadline. It all adds up when we’re all chipping in.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-june25/.u07CFH&refcode=em250627-1-600&t=1&akid=6103%2E6688874%2Ev8gkgA)

subject: For Immediate Release: Oregon GOP Opposes $11 Billion Tax Hike (HB 2025)
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE OREGON REPUBLICAN PARTY (COMMITTEE ID 379) 187 HIGH ST
body:
Mannix broke with taxpayers. We urge a NO vote on HB 2025.

| |

| | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE ** CONTACT: LaJuana Decker, Communications Chair communications.chair@oregon.gop Release Date: June 27, 2025 PRESS RELEASE: The Oregon Republican Party stands firmly opposed to House Bill 2025, one of the largest tax increases in Oregon history. At a time when families are struggling under the weight of high taxes, ballooning housing and property insurance costs, and the ever-rising cost of living in Oregon, it is both tone-deaf and irresponsible to raise taxes and fees by more than $11 billion over the next decade. We are disappointed in yesterday's vote by Representative Kevin Mannix in support of HB 2025. While we recognize the pressures our legislators face, Oregon voters depend on elected Republicans to honor the principles of fiscal responsibility and limited government that are bedrock Republican values. As this bill moves to the House floor, we call on every Republican legislator and those Democrats who have ears to hear the voices of their constituents, to stand united in opposition to this massive and devastating tax increase. We urge concerned Oregonians to respectfully contact their legislators **–** including Representative Mannix **–** and encourage a vote that reflects the will of the people: **Vote NO on HB 2025**. Now is the time for resolve, not retreat. Oregon taxpayers deserve leadership that will protect them from the ever-expanding appetite for taxes in Salem. **Look up contact information for your legislators**[** _here._**](https://links.infooregongop.com/els/v2/7-96C3E~GAB-/Z0RENmJOLzV1RkRqd1hpY2NhRVpna2lHZGpnRVF6Zlp1M21UdXhseVZrQnFtdm16SWFDUlMxaE9IVXRBOHNyUjNDNkFsb2dwd3ZLTmFQcXZyQ2M3UkZneFVWeEpnTDJmQ01sTlZVdGNtWlE9S0/)**Contact Rep. The Squad Victory Fund

---
| **Karrin Taylor Robson Applauds Supreme Court Ruling Upholding Parental Rights** _Trump-Endorsed Conservative Calls the Ruling a Huge Win for Parents and Common Sense._
**PHOENIX, AZ** — Karrin Taylor Robson, Trump-endorsed candidate for Governor of Arizona, today applauded the U.S. Supreme Court’s ruling in favor of parents seeking to opt their children out of elementary school lessons involving LGBTQ storybooks.
“This is a huge win for parents, for religious freedom, and for common sense,” said Taylor Robson. “I’m grateful the Supreme Court protected the right of moms and dads to opt their kids out of radical ideology being pushed in classrooms. This propaganda has no place in public schools, and this ruling is a critical step toward restoring sanity and putting parents back in charge of their children’s education.”
The Montgomery County school board initially allowed parents to opt out, but reversed course a year later.
“As Governor, I will always stand with parents,” Taylor Robson continued. “Our schools should teach reading, writing, and math, not force political agendas on kindergartners.”
Karrin Taylor Robson has made education reform and parental rights a core pillar of her campaign platform, pledging to eliminate woke indoctrination from classrooms and restore academic excellence statewide.

### Join me in my first parade as a State Representative!
Hey friends, Lakewood’s Fourth of July Parade is right around the corner, and I’d love for you to march with me! This is one of the best community events of the year, and a great way to show support, meet neighbors, and celebrate the values we’re fighting for: equality, justice, and a better future for all. **Here’s the info:** 📅 **Parade Date:** Friday, July 4, 2025 (rain or shine)
🕘 **Line-up Time:** Between 9:00–9:30 AM (please arrive by 9:30!)

body:
I’ve written a lot of messages to patriots like you over the years... but never one quite like this.

[Unsubscribe](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xul=2qq8ny363wdaxf3eu1ztoj205zkoppb5pf4yf0fwtqsuzuaxv3546xfxg6vo57qvhd8ru4epvh8qoaswserf766mnbj6eteun24jw0m5u&__stmp=syj4v1&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
\- This tour went somewhere no one thought we’d reach - The Left’s strongholds are crumbling - This generation is choosing freedom - The comeback is happening — and YOU made it possible - This wasn’t just noise... - Packed crowds. Roaring students. The Left? Speechless. - We’re beating the Left. On their turf.

| | | [](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=clt64yr0wtszudkl0ywxfdf6dy5siitlzuc3fxmuni1ztrc6ash1slxa8ttbmy0pe2aa5s0uynh0dsejzjmz8so9ikqajwuwe0hki8qofpm5exehqmmih29b5kl66o94fydsdeoxs0erhfo5rxpjl8ue73zjuhtjqe1hv046frrwmcdtfmek8aqh4h05aexg8dpqbr8nzexw4257xfbsyvcycrb2xminhkcsnj0hciz4my6ytd5b9l7tlf96d2zo4ddzpg2hepm&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=syj4v1&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, I’ve written a lot of messages to patriots like you over the years... but never one quite like this. Because I’ve never had this much good news to share. And I’ve never felt this much urgency to say one thing: **THANK YOU.** I don’t know if you’ve ever felt something just... _shift..._ while it was happening... But this spring on the American Comeback Tour? **I did.** And if you were standing where I stood — listening to the crowd roar before I walked up to the “Prove Me Wrong” table at our Spring Finale at UC Riverside... You would’ve felt this generational shift in real time, too.
---
[](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=clt64yr0wtszudkl0ywxfdf6dy5siitlzw7fzayau6dubbva3oi73mxe5xhwwwadnyrfz6yvmb8isp9eg1avkx898zrrjcxefc8iunb17b83addu7jam729j7pze6475ksn9axp0fe200bycqlv7zqk7i0ein9nxal5fbbki9fna9n80m47l0drter6t5hdxfh8yrvqx52u88bxwledzgn47vwh3w4e6c5sl7g373st3lyqdi1cidwktj1xvloyr3v3xs7y2k5u&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=syj4v1&__onlt=h)
---
You may have seen the photos from the tour... caught some of the videos... read about the chants of _“USA!”_ from students... But let me tell you exactly what happened this spring: **Patriots like you helped launch the most powerful Conservative campus tour in American history.** It was BOLD. It was LOUD. And it was PACKED... From beginning to end. **And the American Comeback Tour’s Spring FINALE was in a place no one thought we’d ever touch: California.** The same state where Leftist professors shut down free speech... where mobs scream in the faces of our students... where conservative ideas aren’t just unpopular — _they’re punishable offenses._ And yet... We filled the campus quad at UC Riverside. Students came early. Packed shoulder-to-shoulder. Ringing around the “Prove Me Wrong” tent to hear the truth. And when I walked on stage and said: “It’s okay to love America...” They ERUPTED.
---
[](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=clt64yr0wtszudkl0ywxfdf6dy5siitlh3erew5iopvqvoxbpmcxgj5xxdlajhj85tbxnbjkupr4ouvpe8003migp57keuitrjyg6lapa2fsmigi439ah3qwny2l1q8ingrrv9uepypedl4fou63hilvhvidf5op8j4zar7x41zb0cbpmg5j00y0ir4tvgj2vr1asz2ut5a7dmp9z1i52bdqhbnlz7g3o7wswlewvc3wqdy25wkddvs3j84rfdlqfbtfsyam5bp&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=syj4v1&__onlt=h)
---
It wasn’t just another great tour stop... **It was a BREAKTHROUGH.** Because this wasn’t the first stop in California this spring — it was the fourth IN MAY and the SIXTH of the tour. And each one was just as powerful... This wasn’t just another campus tour. _It was a line in the sand._ And every single time, the story was the same: The Left tried to dismiss us, hurl their obscenities, or shut us down... The students showed up anyway. And the truth rang out louder than ever before. _But let’s back up for a moment..._ Because while the California finale may have been the last stop of the Spring, this all started months ago. **Back in January, when we were laying out the calendar... These were the goals: Go BIGGER. Go BOLDER. Go DEEPER into Leftist territory.** We wanted to hit not just the battleground states... Not just the safe “Red” states... _But the ones the Left claimed as their own._ And then? We wanted to plant our flag. And because of patriots like you — that’s exactly what we did. **Let me give you the big picture:** ✅ 21 American Comeback Tour stops ✅ Overflow crowds with thousands of students ✅ Deep “Blue” states seeing young people rising up ✅ The Left rattled by a movement of young people who are rejecting them... _wholesale._ Students who had never once heard a Conservative speak in person... _finally heard one._ Students who were afraid to wear a cross or sport an American flag... _were loud, proud, and unashamed to stand for God and their country._ Students who were told they were alone... _realized they were part of something BIGGER than they ever imagined._ There are too many great stories, moments and pictures to pack into this one message... **But just look at what we're accomplishing:**
---
[](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=clt64yr0wtszudkl0ywxfdf6dy5siitlh5m5yzu2ua99dyr6e6ddt85buipw7gxxb1scfsvl6cf01r08kopifrefag8bealbtyldf2l22qdq72fujcz273qep0dx166jszl8s2v7dpzoihrqninpw3qlwt1cxv61v48xh52mwrveln5hdzwje3yzvlmf0k2g4uii6d8dkrwhhjfz10komt4lagu0y1bk6qmlsighi9jw3dg7vhvl9573gssf21ktesfdv07tnta&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=syj4v1&__onlt=h)
---
_Friend, this is why we fight..._ Not just for campus speeches. Not just for questions from students. **But for a generation-wide cultural reset — playing out in real time, in real places, in the hearts of real students.** This is why the American Comeback Tour matters. And I hope you know:**It wouldn’t exist without patriots like****YOU****.** Your support — your prayers, your belief in our students, your generous gifts — made all of this possible. Patriots like you put us on the road. You brought us onto these campuses. You sent us to the students who needed to hear our America First message the most. **You weren’t just watching this tour... You were powering it.** Now, let me be totally honest: _We’re not done. Not even close._ The American Comeback Tour may have just ended for the spring... But this summer? We’re preparing for something even BIGGER. We’re already mapping out new stops in the fall. New states. New targets in Leftist territory to break through. We’re building a plan to take this movement to the next level — to complete the cultural shift that started on this tour. To reach more students. To change more hearts and minds. **And raise up the boldest, most unapologetic generation of freedom-loving Americans since the founding of this country.** _I’m going to need you fighting alongside me, Friend._ Because now that we’ve tasted victory... now that we’ve seen what’s possible... We can’t back down. Not now. _Not ever._ Let’s keep building. Let’s keep pushing. Let’s keep GOING. The American Comeback is well underway. Let’s make sure it keeps rolling strong. **I can’t say “thank you” enough to the patriots like you who’ve helped make Turning Point USA the force it is today.** **Together, we’re SAVING America... one student at a time.**
---
For America, Charlie Kirk
Founder & CEO
Turning Point USA
---
[](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=clt64yr0wtszudkl0ywxfdf6dy5siitlh6dhscg8akl4li8a72ej3v5fs0drtf9l8x7in75lh46hcnt44sdfvwaf0v9seh2jvoobr69cscbo38e5dq0rv3r0qrs70k4kxtv1ohvz54ij1dblnmsz89gr9q6bpilbfnow1gj00frijhyq8slkw6zm7vt4u18xbye3ihr1rbtw0xm0r00vu8uwtla1whxf0x1uofj78fdvee2ok656cck3daf6mnjwd85bxpcat9e&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=syj4v1&__onlt=h)
---
**P.S.** I’ve been doing this for over a decade now, Friend... **_But I’ve never seen momentum like THIS._** These students are ready. They’re hungry for the truth and our ideas. This country is shifting — In a way you can genuinely FEEL. **And the Left is terrified.** You can see it in their mobs... The way they lash out at us and our students... But it’s not working anymore. **Because you and I are reaching the next generation — campus by campus, state by state, student by student.** **And that’s why I’m asking you to stand with us again today. Because every dollar you give today will be MATCHED.** That means your gift of $50 becomes $100... $100 becomes $200... And your impact? DOUBLED. _So, if you believe in this mission... If you’re proud of what we’re accomplishing... If you want to go even BIGGER this fall..._ Then this is your moment to step up and fuel what comes next. Let’s take the American Comeback Tour to every corner of this country when it returns this fall... Let’s train thousands of students this summer at our events to become the LEADERS we need for our America First movement... And let’s make sure the Left NEVER thinks they can own the hearts of America’s young people again. **[We’re not done. Let’s go DEFEAT the Left once and for all. Make your gift to Turning Point USA today and have your impact immediately DOUBLED.](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=clt64yr0wtszudkl0ywxfdf6dy5siitlh89xmg6qh9b08625xkg2bg5jp55mddkoe4l1eje0vtwdr7jlmx5c9bweo8m7f165x1bz19wqh2z9lqcex1peh3r8rg4f0c2lcn2g9aw2ui6t6a0wmaxiis9gknna6mfq3usu8wdbt7o0is2ibmqlo9zih3zrl4qpmcznylxmilq858cpel2cbli5n4g2vbtzgde18cluxpxvtemuoscq8ob3aj5vuxizbltzzd9hz1l&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=syj4v1&__onlt=h)**

From beginning to end. And the American Comeback Tour’s Spring FINALE was in a place no one thought we’d ever touch: California. The same state where Leftist professors shut down free speech... where mobs scream in the faces of our students... where conservative ideas aren’t just unpopular — they’re punishable offenses. And yet... We filled the campus quad at UC Riverside. Students came early. Packed shoulder-to-shoulder. Ringing around the “Prove Me Wrong” tent to hear the truth. And when I walked on stage and said: “It’s okay to love America...” They ERUPTED. It wasn’t just another great tour stop... It was a BREAKTHROUGH. Because this wasn’t the first stop in California this spring — it was the fourth IN MAY and the SIXTH of the tour. And each one was just as powerful... This wasn’t just another campus tour. It was a line in the sand. And every single time, the story was the same: The Left tried to dismiss us, hurl their obscenities, or shut us down... The students showed up anyway. And the truth rang out louder than ever before. But let’s back up for a moment... Because while the California finale may have been the last stop of the Spring, this all started months ago. Let me give you the big picture: ✅ 21 American Comeback Tour stops ✅ Overflow crowds with thousands of students ✅ Deep “Blue” states seeing young people rising up ✅ The Left rattled by a movement of young people who are rejecting them... wholesale. Students who had never once heard a Conservative speak in person... finally heard one. Students who were afraid to wear a cross or sport an American flag... were loud, proud, and unashamed to stand for God and their country. Students who were told they were alone... realized they were part of something BIGGER than they ever imagined. There are too many great stories, moments and pictures to pack into this one message... But just look at what we're accomplishing: Friend, this is why we fight... Not just for campus speeches. Not just for questions from students. If you’re proud of what we’re accomplishing... If you want to go even BIGGER this fall... Then this is your moment to step up and fuel what comes next. | Peter,

Donald Trump is calling it his “Big, Beautiful Bill” — but let’s be clear: **this proposal would be devastating for millions of Americans.** It slashes critical funding for Medicaid and nutrition assistance programs, all while handing out massive tax breaks to the ultra-wealthy.

**These cuts would hurt families across the country — including right here in Sacramento County.** And the priorities behind this bill couldn’t be clearer: punish those who need help the most, and reward those who already have the most.

I’ve seen firsthand how vital programs like Medicaid and SNAP are for patients managing chronic conditions, accessing preventative care, and keeping food on the table. **These aren’t just numbers or data points — they’re people’s lives and livelihoods.**

That’s why I’m doing everything I can in Congress to fight back. But with just days until the FEC deadline, we’re still **$8,200** short of our goal — and how we close this gap will show the strength of our grassroots movement.

It's Sarah McBride.

While running for office, and since starting my first term in Congress earlier this year, I have spent a lot of time thinking about what powers me to do this work. And here's how I would sum it up:

**Freedom, community, and really hot coffee.**

**I ran for office to fight for freedom.** I know how it feels when elected officials, whose sworn duty it is to represent us, attack our most personal and fundamental rights. I absolutely will not stand by while chaotic, irresponsible Republicans neglect the people they were elected to serve, and instead spend their time telling children where they're allowed to go to the bathroom and telling pregnant folks what they're allowed to do in the doctor's office. Every single one of us deserves better from our leaders.

**I am supported by, and will always stand up for, my community.** I got into politics because I want to make life better for everyone, in my home state of Delaware and beyond. I believe that's what good leaders can do — we can make big, bold changes to systems that no longer serve us, or were never meant to include us in the first place. We can take back power from anti-choice, anti-democracy extremists, and we can build a better future.

When it comes to women in politics, you can't talk about freedom or community without talking about my friends at EMILYs List. They've been helping to elect Democratic pro-choice women for 40 years and counting — longer than I've been alive! I know firsthand how powerful the support of this community of five million pro-choice champions can be — [**so it's a privilege to stand with EMILYs List during their crucial End-of-Quarter fundraising drive. Their work is 100% donor-supported, which means your gift goes straight to work electing more women. Please split a donation between EMILYs List and my campaign today. clean_body: I wouldn't be where I am without EMILYs List | = Hi Peter, It's Sarah McBride. While running for office, and since starting my first term in Congress earlier this year, I have spent a lot of time thinking about what powers me to do this work. And here's how I would sum it up: Freedom, community, and really hot coffee. I ran for office to fight for freedom. I know how it feels when elected officials, whose sworn duty it is to represent us, attack our most personal and fundamental rights. I absolutely will not stand by while chaotic, irresponsible Republicans neglect the people they were elected to serve, and instead spend their time telling children where they're allowed to go to the bathroom and telling pregnant folks what they're allowed to do in the doctor's office. Every single one of us deserves better from our leaders. I am supported by, and will always stand up for, my community. I got into politics because I want to make life better for everyone, in my home state of Delaware and beyond. I believe that's what good leaders can do — we can make big, bold changes to systems that no longer serve us, or were never meant to include us in the first place. We can take back power from anti-choice, anti-democracy extremists, and we can build a better future. When it comes to women in politics, you can't talk about freedom or community without talking about my friends at EMILYs List. They've been helping to elect Democratic pro-choice women for 40 years and counting — longer than I've been alive! I know firsthand how powerful the support of this community of five million pro-choice champions can be — = | = And yes, coffee. When I was running for my U.S. House seat, I used my time on the road to visit every single Wawa in the state of Delaware. That's not the most ambitious thing I'll do in my work as a congresswoman, but it was pretty impressive. This week, Peter, I encourage you to think about what fuels you to be in the fight. name: Nellie Pou
subject: Trump and his allies aren't slowing down
body:
I need your help, friend

| |
---
Team, I'll be honest. When the DCCC added me to their Frontline list earlier this year, I knew this was going to be a tough re-election battle. Mike Johnson and the NRCC have been attacking me since my first vote in Congress. A Trump-aligned Super PAC launched a new attack ad in NJ-09, lying about my record. name: Scott Brown
subject: I have something personal to share with you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott Brown for New Hampshire, Inc
body:
Patriot,

My name is Scott Brown, and I want to take a few minutes to share my story
with you and how the experiences and lessons I’ve learned have led me to make a
big decision this week.
I had a challenging upbringing. My mom was married and divorced four times,
and my dad was married and divorced three times. I was raised by my single mom,
who worked multiple jobs to put food on the table. We didn’t have much, but
with the love and support of my grandparents, we had a fighting chance. We
moved often—I lived in 17 different places before I turned 18.

<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/bio-brown-hf-launch-acs/?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_aafh_acs&utm_campaign=20250627_bio-launch_sb>
I know what it’s like to worry about where your next meal is coming from or
whether the bills all get paid.And those early years taught me the value of
grit, of resilience, and hard work.

Nothing in my life has ever been handed to me — I’ve had to fight for every
step forward.

I worked my way through college and law school, taking any odd job and doing
whatever it took to stay afloat.

At 19, I joined the Army National Guard. I served for more than 30 years and
retired as a Colonel. I’ve worn our nation’s uniform with pride and know
firsthand what it means to serve a cause bigger than yourself.

<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/bio-brown-hf-launch-acs/?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_aafh_acs&utm_campaign=20250627_bio-launch_sb>
Back in 2010, I took a leap that many thought was crazy. I ran for the U.S.
Senate in Massachusetts as a Republican,driven by a belief that people like you
deserved a real voice in Washington, not just another career politician. I
drove across the state, putting countless miles on my beloved truck, a 2005 GMC
Canyon. With the incredible support of grassroots supporters like you from all
corners of the country,we pulled off a stunning upset and won, shaking the
political establishment to its core.

But that victory was just the start.

I went to Washington as a disruptor, refusing to play the insider games of
career politicians. That made me a target. The national Democrats zeroed in,
recruiting Elizabeth Warren and pouring tens of millions into a campaign to
defeat me. Despite our best efforts, we came up short in that race.

But I wasn’t discouraged. I believed then, and I believe now, that there’s a
bigger plan for all of us.

My wife, Gail, and I became four-time grandparents, and we’ve poured our
hearts into our family and our New Hampshire community. In 2017, when President
Trump asked me to serve as U.S. Ambassador to New Zealand and Samoa,I was
honored to represent our nation, strengthen global partnerships, and protect
American interests abroad.
<https://secure.winred.com/nrsc/doge-hit-ground-running-tc-rs-hf/?recurring=true&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&address=&zip=&city=&state=&employer_name=&occupation=&amtposition=4>

<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/bio-brown-hf-launch-acs/?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_aafh_acs&utm_campaign=20250627_bio-launch_sb>
Today, I’m writing to you with big news: I’m not done fighting. Our country’s
future is at a crossroads, and I’m stepping up again to run for the U.S. Senate

I was raised by my single mom, who worked multiple jobs to put food on the table. We didn’t have much, but with the love and support of my grandparents, we had a fighting chance. ## 82-Year-Old to Debut in Powerlifting Competition
Faith O'Reilly, 82, from Saguache, Colorado, is making headlines as the [oldest female competitor in powerlifting's debut](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGS3CAQheHTSFmrBCMhNiBwMtk6dahCokF4Ea2CnqV0e9fYR_AF_nrv-_W5ftqYYg4_7YnGB7-ypzVjqwmZsawnnlTuna6tvHZsMaVYbXa2rnKUM4wK5LI6G9O9Tr0zHlHio0cjllmM86Rn2R9GaaX0B9pdCanUpLRwfhNeC6GVFnrvo3nXRiUXOY7LQwzL8hDK62mTHzi5eeumEV1kKsNvipkP9OmmbyzDTmefzMF81e7xo5PPTj5ba0Mgcu8bGblR-RqohE4-L2pYUvQccwAmcLi9GCzDq0LFHKlAsCdWaAcWBC3hRluAkoNQbHYn8YEFmK4KfCDYgFBs_or5Xe-Lcdc_IrV00xhOG9PfhfzftN9G_gkAAP__TjiSaw) at the 2025 National Senior Games, set for July 24-Aug. 4 in Des Moines, Iowa. A former Iowa state powerlifting champion, O'Reilly picked up the sport in law school and kept training after retiring to rural Colorado. She credits powerlifting with preserving her strength, bone health, and independence, and encourages other older adults to try the sport. O'Reilly is no stranger to the senior games. In 2023, she teamed up with her younger sister and childhood friend to win gold in the women's 75+ triathlon relay, forming the "[Fab Fem](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2O6yAUBOCnwR0RPmDjFBS3cZfbbolwOBhW_ET4bCK__Sq7j7DTjvRJMx83e3Mpp7r_dwVN2IOl0GzF15GRCLstWFo_7-2x9a87vlLO6XDVu8OCgImLmYO23qV8WjV4ExAB5YBm1NMoJrVMMEQDUwhXGINepPc4y1mOG0q8qsXDO0Myb03MoEEILceL1nKcw6I2uKLy08aUQJ-o9ctnS5Uihny2J_bLvZUhm0j0OJj8x2BlsNZjd--CweooZiTkLXCKyEurFHlwiSJvHVPOJ4N16MY_fqfNmimxF5fyj0x_vuRp4DsAAP__SXJ3Kg)" trio. Now, she's excited to return to Des Moines, where she grew up, and prove that age is no barrier to strength. _Podcast host Amy Hess dives deeper into this story, with video, in today's Feel Good Friday podcast episode._ ([Watch Now](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OqzAUhJ8Gd6DDwT-kcHGbdLnVSiktGx8HrwyOjBPE26_YPMK2M5pPmu9-MzcbU1wf_-1COjyCqSGblfYtUa1UzEJLLseUn668JtpjSnGzq7ebQUDRgmxRGW9jOgxnXgcipIGR7pXoQfBRIJv12FuYwijFBTmglN45lAiWX_gAKCSL-qSBRIUAaug7pYZehpE7vBD3wjUcyMeaS_ed41pnCunIbyrdlBeW9Fzrc2uGfw1eG7zu-94d-VVfjs7-DDncbZ3m9mum9vqZsqL983NIqobDY7Ex_fLqn0W8Nf4EAAD__wotcrQ))
## ‘Memory Cop’ Nabs 3,000 Suspects
British transport officer Andy Pope has identified over 3,000 suspected criminals using his remarkable ability to recall faces, earning him the nickname “[Memory Cop.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGSpCAYBOCn0Qzr5wdEA4JLJptLL6RQfpRbEEuZmfLtt2bnETbv6q6v_93t3cUUt-Wvy2TCEmwNxW70OhPVSofNlMtxzWWfjsdMr5hSPN3m3WkRUDHoGWrrXUyXla03gQhJtGS4VhyUHBS2qwE98F4Gr8bRizF44TigGJFgEDN63UbzboMeNQJowTutBe_DICccSXo1NRLIx1qO7n-JW10ppKs86ejmkttk1lr3sxF_Grw1eHt8dW9Bd7m1lHeiwdvHweaynyzHzbMplVfcFhbcTAwGDohajd1ac2oP4_cPtdeNhCW7mH6W6q8vehr8DgAA__9e13vL)” His knack for remembering faces—even years after seeing them in photos or [grainy CCTV](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DuSqzAQheHVQCZKNOIVKLgJmW86IaVHCzQWakqSTXn3Ux4vYTZw6vzf1229KR983P6rA6Xb3FocrRGvHLAUTOuBB6WXoVOnh8HLh-CzilblFTj0jA8MxtUqH16rqK10iIBdjbId-5b3Yuqh3qUQ0Ck9t_NkQHfTYGeuZz60GsD1xva1l-81PsAInI9d24xj1w5uEhpmFLbXleBofaHUfJOPZUcXXvTE1Bg66iD3Us5cdf8qWCpYrutqNiL7zohYLkr3htJWweKUQZbQ0BZ98RRZvvsQMiPHyo7sE8sMnUyZ3eMTMzt8tEwHunzcWMc5Z_mRTzQlM0ePaCtY6iTt-aEZxkrw7VA-_D4rfyZ9SvgJAAD__-zWj30)—has led to arrests tied to offenses including attempted murder and sexual assault. Even during the Covid pandemic, when many suspects wore masks, Pope identified them with uncanny precision. A founding member of the [Association of Super Recognisers](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykjzFyhSAUAE8DnQ4-gacFRRq7nzYlg_JQMigOkv_H22eSHCEH2J3dj4d9uJjisb67nUxYg60h24NeV6Jaqdid9lzuJZ9z-VroFVOKlzu8uywIUI3QDaD1LqbbSu5NIALqOZkOVSeUHBTwzTihnR_VLEf0OMx6cQqFH4PUqBbdDTyaH5vQgCAE9l2L2Hc6DHKGkaRXM5OCfKy5tJ85HnWjkO78pNIueefJbLWeF-vfGEwMJtdcTWlzWRlMvBh__mVrZFKsu4vpl6r_3n0a-A4AAP__VZBpug), he was honored with a Chief Constable’s Award and says he just wants to help keep communities safe, though he admits he’s hopeless with birthdays and anniversaries.
## Abandoned Beagle Becomes Hero in Japan
In Gosen City, Japan, a beagle once rejected for being too loud [saved a Buddhist monk](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0MGu2yAUBNCvwTsifI3Bb8Eir5XVRdMuWqlLC8y1Q4O5EZBY7tdXaT_h7UejmfPrMl1siCGt3-yGZlmXqS40JdxLxFoxTxtulI-Z7i4_ZtxDjKHY5G2ZQEDPheKgJ29DPCbZeLMgAnYNmlb3rejl0ENzNXJ46wbrFoABnep6p1vltRqg1VI7hCaYV5tQoEEI3bUnrbtWLYN08IbS945JgT5UyqffFFK94hIPemI-zbQ10VxrvRfWnRmMDMZ930_lkdJRbsefV4LBuBJ5_vrFYOwHoRiMZ2eTp4Sef6aVf08z8k82RvT8JxH_Sg_P33GmDQv_gpn4D_vEwi-UbnzMtPF3tJmfa7XzrcnG3__jKM2kWDcb4r9t9cOoTwN_AwAA__8iko14) from a bear attack. Tougen Yoshihara, the abbot of Youkoku Temple, was walking his 1-year-old beagle, Chico, in the woods when a bear appeared on their path. Startled, Yoshihara fell and dislocated his shoulder as he tried to flee. Chico sprang into action, barking furiously and charging the bear, successfully scaring it off and protecting his owner. The dog had previously been returned to a kennel [for his loud barking](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSrCAURL9GMyxEFF9A8JLJZtMNLeRe8M4iWIAz5d9vze4nbNxd3XXO5325GwoU_YfZUTvvlurSEvFVAtaKedlxT_my6VjzafFFIVAxEUxZBBcj4xMTagFD4VpkC9ohChxa1L0aez7KeRTtpi0grqtENyspJwPgjLIS1dw7OwCHlvR7jU9CCc7V0HdKDf3kZrmKfyhhXBvJEaim3D0SxbqhC1d6Yu5s2tugt1qP0gz_G3FrxK3E0_uA3Xm8Uq7b9S414gbJs4zFnghsvdjDHCZiQban-MUyHuYqzBmq2zst5knRs40KC-SwzRqOX_pJNZL73VD4Oa9_tvbU4jsAAP__CxSG3Q)—a trait that turned out to be life-saving. Now recovering, Yoshihara calls Chico his “savior” and says the pup has earned a place by his side, both at home and in spirit.

subject: Amidst the Politics, a Bipartisan Moment of Reflection on Capitol Hill

body:
| | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/6d21325bd1c6/bats-brews-and-a-birthday-salute-to-the-us-army-14053199?e=33f53a5b1a)
---
| | | |
---
| | | | [ ](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=6ca1c31d6e&e=33f53a5b1a)
---
| Friends,

Three years ago, With Honor Action and the For Country Caucus were proud to be a part of an effort to honor the U.S. Army Ranger veterans of World War II with a Congressional Gold Medal.

Once 7,000 strong, only five of them remain with us today. At yesterday's ceremony to unveil the medal, we were reminded—soberingly and powerfully—that freedom is never free. Times of great need are always answered by Americans who rise without hesitation to lead the way.

On Thursday morning, two of the remaining five veterans were able to come to Washington, D.C., to be awarded the Congressional Gold Medal. In honoring Pfc. John M. Wardell and Sgt. Joseph A. Drake, who accepted the medal on behalf of the group, Rep. Jason Crow said:
> "Our nation always encounters struggle...it's never customs [or] institutions that save us. **_It's Americans that decide they will lead the way_**. And it's in that spirit...that we say that today...That regardless of what we face, regardless of how insurmountable the odds will be, [that] Americans will draw inspiration from those heroes whose shoulders we stand upon."
This historic recognition was made possible by the leadership of former For Country Caucus Co-Chair Rep. Jason Crow, who is an Army Ranger veteran, former Vice Chair Rep. Mariannette Miller-Meeks, a 24-year Army veteran, ally Senator Joni Ernst, a 23-year Army veteran, and Senator Tammy Duckworth, a 23-year combat-wounded Army veteran.

So, despite the political food fights and less-than-civil disagreements in Washington, D.C., we were glad to be part of a truly bipartisan event of reflection and unity, even if it was only for a moment.
---
|
---
| **Bipartisan For Country Caucus members introduce With Honor Action-supported legislation to connect veterans to energy and manufacturing careers**
---
| [ ](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=3685987566&e=33f53a5b1a)
---
| Earlier this week, For Country Caucus members Reps. Chrissy Houlahan and Jen Kiggans introduced the Veterans Energy Transition (VET) Act, a bipartisan bill that would help veterans, service members who are transitioning out of the military, and their spouses gain the training needed for high-demand jobs in energy and advanced manufacturing.

Specifically, the bill expands the Department of Defense's SkillBridge and the Department of Labor's Transition Assistance Program by creating a grant program for energy and advanced manufacturing employers to hire, train, certify, and retain eligible veterans, transitioning service members, and their spouses. The bill also prioritizes support for veterans with service-connected disabilities or who are experiencing homelessness.
---
|
---
| **With Honor Action Supports Homeownership for Servicemembers and Veterans**
---
|
---
| At the Veterans Association of Real Estate Professionals' (VAREP)13th Annual Policy Conference, the With Honor Action team engaged with veteran real estate professionals from around the country to learn more about barriers to homeownership for the military community. The conference highlighted two pieces of legislation that With Honor Action endorsed this week: [H.R. ](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=9c5de3a3f3&e=33f53a5b1a)[3694](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=dcb798207f&e=33f53a5b1a) / [S. 1932](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=955333a97c&e=33f53a5b1a) and H.R. 3981. Both pieces of legislation would open the door to homeownership for our military community and address the lack of home loan information for service members and veterans. We thank For Country Caucus member Jen Kiggans in particular for helping lead the charge on [H.R. 3981](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=2bb803e75c&e=33f53a5b1a).
---
|
---
| [ ](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=84a316e011&e=33f53a5b1a)
---
| In case you missed it, For Country Caucus members Reps. Zach Nunn and Jimmy Panetta were interviewed shortly before their return from a trip to the Middle East, where they offered their thoughts on Iran. Said Nunn, an Air Force Colonel who's conducted intel-reconnaissance missions:
> "[CENTCOM Commander Kurilla] has been very clear here that Iran needs to take the offramp from its nuclear enrichment program. In fact, he was one of the ones that highlighted here the real threat coming from a nuclear Iran, both to its neighbor Israel, and other nations across the Middle East. The United States has a very important role to play here in deterrence," he said.
Panetta added:
> "...we were able to have very substantive meetings with some of the leadership in Saudi Arabia, in Bahrain, and here in the United Arab Emirates before we have to fly out tonight...And what we heard consistently is -- none of them want a nuclear-armed Iran."
You can watch the full interview with Fox News [here](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=a980eb2c38&e=33f53a5b1a).

Florida officials led the media on a tour of their abandoned airfield turned[ internment camp ](https://substack.com/redirect/72eb3973-5e10-4e2e-b7a2-df430f9b2570?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)yesterday, in what DeSantis [would really like you to call ](https://substack.com/redirect/e32b3fc4-5c1b-40a8-ac5a-a291c30326bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)"Alligator Alcatraz."
An estimated 1,000 people will be living there in makeshift tents, guarded primarily by the dangerous animals known to roam the Florida Everglades.
And for Florida -- that seems to be[ a selling point.](https://substack.com/redirect/2e108aad-77f6-4f04-8b9d-58c7de8c13ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
DeSantis plans to spend $450 million per year in taxpayer money for this latest stunt.
A more appropriate term for this death camp would be Alligator Auschwitz...

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: 10 ways Republicans are making your life more expensive
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
From driving up grocery bills to skyrocketing health care premiums, Americans are about to see their costs go up thanks to Republicans.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2582%2E4032634%2EKws3qT)
---
That Big Beautiful Bill Trump and his yes-men in Congress are pushing? It’s going to make your life more expensive. I’ve read the bill — and I want to share ten ways this bill will increase costs for people. **One, your utility bills may go up.** Why? The Republicans’ bill will get rid of investments we’ve made in clean energy. We need that energy, and the Republican bill takes our country backwards. It also means that the price of electricity will go up for American families like yours. **Two, your rent could go up.** How? Republicans are trying to block state and local governments from fighting schemes that predatory housing companies use to artificially jack up the price of rent. **Three,** if you’re a kid from a working-class family and don’t have the money to write one check to pay for college, Republicans will make tuition even more expensive for you. That’s right — Republicans are cutting Pell Grants. **Four, Republicans are making your student loan payments go up.** Independent experts explain that by changing how student loan repayment plans work, Republicans could raise your student loan payments by an average of $400 a month. **Five, Republicans are making it more expensive to go to medical school.** I can’t believe I have to say this, but rich kids shouldn’t be the only people who can become doctors. But this bill would limit how much you can take out in loans to go to medical school. **Six, Republicans are making the cost of groceries go up.** They are cutting food assistance — or SNAP — by nearly $200 per person per year. More than seven million people will have less help, including more than four million people who will lose their food assistance altogether. **Seven, Republicans are increasing the cost of prescription drugs for millions of Americans.** By demanding that states require higher copays for prescription drugs — from $4 to $35 — the cost of a prescription will go up nearly 900% for low-income people on Medicaid. **Eight, Republicans will send your Affordable Care Act premiums skyrocketing,** pushing them up by thousands — and in some cases tens of thousands — of dollars every year. **Nine, Republicans will drive up the cost of private health insurance.** More than half of all Americans get their insurance from their employer. When a portion of the uncompensated care is shifted to private insurers, experts estimate that the costs to your family will increase by hundreds of dollars a year. **Ten, Republicans are ripping health insurance away entirely from 16 million people.** For those people who will be uninsured, the cost of essential services like X-rays and blood tests will go up. A trip to the emergency room, if God forbid there’s an accident, could mean they go bankrupt. [**This is the moment to raise your voice. Make a call to your senators and tell them: We don’t want our costs to go up so that Jeff Bezos can buy his third yacht. Keeping up the pressure on Congress can help stop this bill from passing.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/call/wfs-call-senators/?source=EMZ26M_GOP_E_20250627_V1S1&t=8&akid=2582%2E4032634%2EKws3qT) | [**MAKE A CALL**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/call/wfs-call-senators/?source=EMZ26M_GOP_E_20250627_V1S1&t=9&akid=2582%2E4032634%2EKws3qT)

Elizabeth
