With the key deadlines and the end of the quarter approaching, I need your help to stop MAGA Republicans from flipping New Jersey red.
Peter, it’s been a few weeks since I won the Democratic nomination for governor of New Jersey. But this race is already a rollercoaster — we’ve seen an outpouring of grassroots support and also faced a barrage of right-wing attacks.
With the key deadlines and the end of the quarter approaching, I need your help to stop MAGA Republicans from flipping New Jersey red, and I’m humbly asking you to **[split $5 between my team and Heartland Patriots to power our campaign to victory.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/90712?refcode=em20250627-9055&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9055%2E614464%2EwweOIc)** But if you’re not sure (which I understand!), here are five reasons I hope will convince you:
**1) New Jersey is not a safe Democratic state anymore — far from it.** The last governor’s election here? It was decided by 3%. New Jersey’s margin in the 2024 presidential election? 6%. The latest polling in this race since we entered the general election? It shows me leading my GOP opponent by only 3%.
**2) Donald Trump is going to do everything he can to defeat me in this race.** He’s already endorsed my opponent, Jack Ciattarelli, and led a rally for him — meaning MAGA money from all over the country is going to pour into Ciattarelli’s campaign.
**3) Unlike my opponent, I won’t ever hesitate to stand up to Trump when he attacks New Jersey families.** I’ve sworn an oath to the Constitution, and I’ve spent my career honoring it to the best of my ability every single day — before loyalty to any other politician or political party. Ciattarelli has already made clear that his number-one priority is staying in Trump’s good graces.
**4) My top priority as governor will be making life more affordable for New Jersey families.** I’ve put forward detailed plans for lowering the cost of everything from housing and energy to health care, child care, and groceries — and I’m going to hit the ground running on Day 1 making them a reality.
**5) The stakes of this race are high not only for New Jersey, but for the country.** This is our chance to show the entire nation that the people reject the Trump administration’s incompetence and authoritarianism. And it’s our chance to get started on a better path forward — one where we prioritize doing what’s best for working families over what’s best for billionaires and corrupt political allies. There is no more important bellwether ahead of 2026.
**[If any of these reasons speaks to you, I hope you will split a $5 end-of-quarter donation between my team and Heartland Patriots to help me defeat my Trump-endorsed opponent in this incredibly competitive election to determine who leads our state for the next four years.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/90712?refcode=em20250627-9055&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=9055%2E614464%2EwweOIc)**
**[DONATE →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/90712?refcode=em20250627-9055&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=9055%2E614464%2EwweOIc)**
Thanks for reading, and have a great rest of your day.
-Mikie

clean_body: | | | Friend, Lauren Boebert supports Donald Trump’s plan to send ICE into Democratic cities — not to secure the border, but to punish political opponents and sow fear in immigrant communities. Let’s call it what it is: government-sanctioned retaliation. This isn’t about safety. It’s about control. It’s about cruelty. Meanwhile, Boebert just voted for a budget that explodes our national debt, guts Medicaid, and makes life harder for working families across Colorado’s 4th District. She’s not fighting for rural America — she’s fighting for her own spotlight. John has been out in towns like Bennett, Hudson, Hugo, and Yuma — and he's met the families who make this district work. Some are undocumented. Many fled from unimaginable violence. All of them are working 60, 70, even 80 hours a week on farms and ranches that are barely staying afloat. They’re harvesting our food, tending our livestock, raising their kids — and living in fear that they’ll be ripped away from everything they’ve built by government agents in tactical gear. This is not border security. It’s a masked, taxpayer-funded Gestapo. And it has no place in a country that claims to stand for freedom and justice. The truth is, small family farms and ranches in Eastern Colorado depend on immigrant labor. These workers aren’t a threat — they’re the backbone of our rural economy. It’s time we stop treating them like political pawns and start offering them a real path to citizenship and dignity. We don’t have to accept this kind of fear-driven politics. We can defeat Lauren Boebert. We can choose compassion over cruelty, common sense over chaos, and unity over hate. Derek, We’re about to ask you to **[donate directly to the DNC before our end-of-quarter deadline.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-june-2025?refcode=em_20250627_3758_fr&amount=3&refcode2=3758_22930333_TlFlph&akid=3758%2E22930333%2ETlFlph)** If you give us a moment of your time, we’ll explain why your support is so important right now. Here’s the situation: Trump is abusing his powers to fulfill his campaign of revenge and retribution. His reckless economic agenda is raising costs for working families. He’s actively working to dismantle our government and our democracy as it stands. **There has never been a more important time for Democrats to take action. With your help, that’s exactly what we’re doing here at the DNC:** We’ve organized over 100 town halls in nearly every state to talk with voters about their concerns and what’s at stake. We just launched a daily livestream where we’ll communicate to the American people exactly what Trump and his allies are doing, and give people more opportunities to get involved. But the truth is, these programs take a lot to keep running. When we hit our fundraising goals, we’re able to allocate resources effectively — ensuring that we can continue the fight against Trump while laying the groundwork to win elections this year, take back Congress in 2026, and the White House in 2028. **That’s why reaching our end-of-quarter fundraising goal is so important.
